# AR Poster Website - Technische Documentatie

## Project Overview
Een AR (Augmented Reality) webapplicatie voor het scannen van fysieke posters en het tonen van interactieve AR content. De website werkt op mobiele devices (iOS/Android) en desktop, met automatische detectie en verschillende weergavemodi.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend Framework**: A-Frame 1.4.2 (WebGL/Three.js wrapper)
- **AR Library**: MindAR 1.2.5 (image tracking)
- **Backend**: PHP (SQLite database)
- **Server**: Node.js (development) / Apache (production)
- **Database**: SQLite (posters.db)

### 2. AR Image Tracking System
**Files**: index.html (lines 138-144), main.js (lines 407-485)

#### A. MindAR Configuration
```html
<a-scene
  id="ar-scene"
  mindar-image="
    imageTargetSrc: assets/nft/AR_test_01/AR_test_01.mind;
    autoStart: true;
    maxTrack: 1;
    filterMinCF: 0.003;      /* Minimum cutoff freq (higher = more filtering) */
    filterBeta: 0.025;       /* Smoothing coefficient (0 = instant, 1 = max smooth) */
    warmupTolerance: 5;      /* Initial detection tolerance */
    missTolerance: 5;        /* Frames before losing tracking */
  "
  embedded
  vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
  renderer="
    colorManagement: true;
    antialias: false;        /* Disabled for Safari performance */
    alpha: true;
    logarithmicDepthBuffer: true;
    precision: mediump;      /* Safari compatibility */
    powerPreference: high-performance;
  "
>
```

**Tracking Parameters Explained**:
- **filterMinCF**: 0.003 = Minimal filtering, fast response
- **filterBeta**: 0.025 = Light smoothing, balances jitter vs lag
- **warmupTolerance**: 5 = Moderate detection speed
- **missTolerance**: 5 = Keeps tracking during brief occlusions

#### B. 3-Layer AR System
**File**: main.js (lines 430-468)

```javascript
// Layer 1: Base layer on poster surface
const layer1 = document.createElement('a-plane');
layer1.setAttribute('position', '0 0 0.001');  // 1mm above poster
layer1.setAttribute('width', '1.1');
layer1.setAttribute('height', '1.54');
layer1.setAttribute('material', 'src: img/Drone_1.png; shader: flat; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double');

// Layer 2: Mid-depth hover
const layer2 = document.createElement('a-plane');
layer2.setAttribute('position', '0 0 0.15');  // 15cm above poster
layer2.setAttribute('width', '1.1');
layer2.setAttribute('height', '1.54');
layer2.setAttribute('material', 'src: img/Drone_2.png; ...');

// Layer 3: Furthest with slow breathing animation
const layer3 = document.createElement('a-plane');
layer3.setAttribute('position', '0 0 0.25');  // 25cm above poster
layer3.setAttribute('width', '1.15');
layer3.setAttribute('height', '1.61');
layer3.setAttribute('material', 'src: img/Drone_3.png; ...');

// Slow, subtle animations (6-8 second cycles)
layer3.setAttribute('animation__x', 'property: position.x; from: -0.01; to: 0.01; dur: 6000; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad');
layer3.setAttribute('animation__y', 'property: position.y; from: -0.005; to: 0.005; dur: 7000; ...');
layer3.setAttribute('animation__z', 'property: position.z; from: 0.245; to: 0.255; dur: 8000; ...');
layer3.setAttribute('animation__scale', 'property: scale; from: 0.99 0.99 0.99; to: 1.01 1.01 1.01; dur: 8000; ...');
```

**Design Rationale**:
- **Layer spacing**: Progressive depth creates 3D effect
- **Animation timing**: 6-8s cycles = calm "breathing" effect
- **Movement range**: ±1cm to avoid appearing disconnected from poster
- **Easing**: easeInOutQuad = smooth, organic motion

### 3. Camera Feed Black & White Filter
**Files**: index.html (line 90), main.js (line 195)

```css
/* Applied to all video elements */
filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95);
```

**Effect**:
- Camera feed → High-contrast B&W
- AR layers → Full color
- Creates visual separation between real world and AR content

### 4. Database Schema
**File**: config.php (lines 20-75)

```sql
CREATE TABLE posters (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  subtitle TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  image_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  thumbnail_path TEXT,
  latitude REAL,
  longitude REAL,
  artikel_link TEXT,
  photographer_credit TEXT,
  ar_marker TEXT,              -- Links to .mind file (e.g., "assets/nft/AR_test_01/AR_test_01")
  downloads INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now'))
);
```

**Key Fields**:
- `ar_marker`: Path to MindAR marker file (without .mind extension)
- `image_path`: Full-size poster image
- `thumbnail_path`: Grid thumbnail

### 5. AR Marker Matching System
**File**: main.js (lines 520-570)

```javascript
// When MindAR detects a target
target.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
  // 1. Get the marker file from scene
  const sceneMarker = scene.getAttribute('mindar-image').imageTargetSrc;
  // Example: "assets/nft/AR_test_01/AR_test_01.mind"
  
  // 2. Load all posters from database
  const allPosters = window.allPosters; // Fetched at AR init
  
  // 3. Match poster by ar_marker field
  const matchedPoster = allPosters.find(p => {
    return p.ar_marker && sceneMarker.includes(p.ar_marker);
  });
  
  // 4. Update footer with poster title
  if (matchedPoster) {
    document.getElementById('detected-poster-title').textContent = matchedPoster.title;
  }
});
```

**Flow**:
1. User scans physical poster with camera
2. MindAR detects marker pattern
3. System extracts marker filename from scene
4. Database lookup via `ar_marker` column
5. Display matched poster metadata in footer

### 6. Mobile UI: Expandable Footer
**Files**: index.html (lines 165-180), main.js (lines 602-705)

#### States:
1. **State 1**: Gallery (collapsed) - "Alle Posters" + chevron
2. **State 2**: Detected Poster - Title + close button
3. **State 3**: Gallery (expanded) - Full poster grid overlay

```javascript
// Swipe detection
let startY, currentY, isDragging = false;

footerHeader.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  isDragging = true;
});

footerHeader.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  if (!isDragging) return;
  currentY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  const deltaY = currentY - startY;
  
  if (deltaY < -50) {  // Swipe up threshold
    expandFooter();
  }
});
```

**Expansion Logic**:
- Swipe up → Show gallery overlay (100vh)
- Tap "X" → Collapse to state 1
- Poster detected → Auto-switch to state 2

## MindAR Marker Generation
**Tool**: nft-generator (AR.js NFT Marker Creator)

### Process:
```bash
cd nft-generator
node app.js -i ../uploads/poster-image.jpg -o ../assets/nft/poster-name
```

**Output**:
- `poster-name.mind` - Compiled marker (used by MindAR)
- `poster-name.fset` - Feature set
- `poster-name.fset3` - Compressed features
- `poster-name.iset` - Image set

### Requirements:
- High-contrast image
- Clear features (edges, textures)
- Minimum 480px resolution
- Good lighting in original photo

## Camera Permissions & iOS Compatibility

### iOS Specific:
```html
<video autoplay playsinline muted webkit-playsinline x-webkit-airplay="deny" preload="auto">
```

**Attributes Explained**:
- `playsinline`: Prevents fullscreen on iOS
- `webkit-playsinline`: Safari legacy support
- `muted`: Required for autoplay on iOS
- `x-webkit-airplay="deny"`: Prevents AirPlay interference

### Camera Request:
```javascript
// Try multiple camera configs for compatibility
const cameraConfigs = [
  { video: { facingMode: { exact: 'environment' }, width: { ideal: 1920 }, height: { ideal: 1080 } } },
  { video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 } } },
  { video: { facingMode: 'environment' } },
  { video: true }  // Fallback to any camera
];

for (const config of cameraConfigs) {
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(config);
    return stream;  // Success - use this config
  } catch (err) {
    continue;  // Try next config
  }
}
```

## Performance Optimizations

### Safari-Specific:
1. **Renderer settings**:
   ```javascript
   antialias: false               // Safari performs better without AA
   precision: mediump             // Safari doesn't support highp well
   logarithmicDepthBuffer: true   // Better depth precision
   ```

2. **Video elements**:
   - Two video elements: background + MindAR internal
   - Both set to `z-index: -1` (behind AR canvas)
   - Both have B&W filter applied

3. **Canvas layering**:
   ```css
   canvas {
     z-index: 10;      /* AR content on top */
     pointer-events: none;  /* Allow touch through to UI */
   }
   ```

## Common Issues & Solutions

### Issue 1: "AR freezes when changing settings"
**Cause**: A-Frame scene cannot be updated runtime  
**Solution**: Removed debug panel, hardcoded optimal settings

### Issue 2: "Layers float away from poster"
**Cause**: Animation ranges too large OR tracking too slow  
**Solution**: 
- Reduced layer spacing (25cm → 15cm → 25cm optimal)
- Tuned filterBeta (0.025) for balance
- Slowed animations (6-8s cycles)

### Issue 3: "Black screen on camera switch"
**Cause**: MindAR video stream not updated  
**Solution**: Removed camera switching feature

### Issue 4: "Video 0 has width: 0, height: 0"
**Cause**: One video is background placeholder, other is MindAR's internal  
**Solution**: Normal behavior - background video shows camera, internal video is hidden

// Apply lens distortion compensation for ultrawide camera
function applyLensDistortionCompensation(zoomLevel) {
    console.log(`🔧 Applying lens distortion compensation for zoom level: ${zoomLevel}`);
    
    // For ultrawide (0.5x), we need to compensate for barrel distortion
    const isUltrawide = zoomLevel <= 0.6;
    
    if (isUltrawide) {
        console.log('📐 Detected ultrawide lens - applying barrel distortion compensation');
        
        // Apply CSS-based barrel distortion correction to video feed
        const videoElements = document.querySelectorAll('#camera-feed, video');
        videoElements.forEach(video => {
            // Slight pincushion effect to counter barrel distortion
            // This is a subtle correction - too much looks unnatural
            video.style.transform = 'perspective(1000px) translateZ(-10px)';
            video.style.transformOrigin = 'center center';
        });
        
        // Adjust Three.js camera FOV for ultrawide perspective
        setTimeout(() => {
            const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
            if (scene && scene.camera) {
                const camera = scene.camera;
                
                // Ultrawide lenses have ~120° FOV, but we want MindAR to match it
                // Standard camera FOV is ~60-70°, ultrawide is ~90-120°
                // We'll increase FOV to compensate
                const originalFov = camera.fov || 70;
                const ultrawideCompensationFov = originalFov * 1.4; // ~98° for better alignment
                
                camera.fov = ultrawideCompensationFov;
                camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
                
                console.log(`📷 Adjusted camera FOV: ${originalFov}° → ${ultrawideCompensationFov}° for ultrawide`);
                
                // Store for reference
                window.cameraFovCompensation = ultrawideCompensationFov;
            }
        }, 500);
        
    } else {
        console.log('📐 Standard lens detected - no distortion compensation needed');
        window.cameraFovCompensation = null;
    }
}

        // MindAR anchors incorrectly with ultrawide - apply positional offset

// Request camera permission
async function requestCameraPermission() {
    console.log('📸 Requesting camera permission...');
    
    // Try different camera configurations
    // NOTE: Ultrawide (0.5x) causes MindAR anchor offset issues
    // Prioritize 1x standard lens for accurate AR tracking
    const cameraConfigs = [
        // Config 1: Standard 1x camera with high resolution (best for MindAR)
        {
            video: { 
                facingMode: { exact: 'environment' },
                width: { ideal: 1920 },
                height: { ideal: 1080 }
            }
        },
        // Config 2: Standard back camera
        {
            video: { 
                facingMode: 'environment',
                width: { ideal: 1280 },
                height: { ideal: 720 }
            }
        },
        // Config 3: Any back camera
        {
            video: { 
                facingMode: 'environment'
            }
        },
        // Config 4: Default camera
        {
            video: true
        }
    ];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < cameraConfigs.length; i++) {
        try {
            console.log(`📸 Trying camera config ${i + 1}/${cameraConfigs.length}...`);
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(cameraConfigs[i]);
            console.log('✅ Camera permission granted with config', i + 1);
            console.log('📹 Stream:', stream);
            
            const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
            const settings = track.getSettings();
            const capabilities = track.getCapabilities ? track.getCapabilities() : {};
            
            console.log('📹 Track settings:', settings);
            console.log('📹 Camera capabilities:', capabilities);
            console.log('📹 Camera facing:', settings.facingMode || 'unknown');
            console.log('📹 Resolution:', `${settings.width}x${settings.height}`);
            
            // Store default zoom (1x standard lens)
            // Ultrawide causes MindAR positioning errors
            window.cameraZoomLevel = 1.0;
            console.log(`✅ Using 1.0x standard lens (MindAR compatible)`);
            
            // Apply distortion compensation with standard lens (minimal)
            applyLensDistortionCompensation(1.0);

- content:

```
const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const multer = require('multer');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const { v4: uuidv4 } = require('uuid');
const sharp = require('sharp');

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Middleware
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.static('.'));

// Configure multer for file uploads
const storage = multer.diskStorage({
    destination: (req, file, cb) => {
        const uploadDir = './uploads';
        if (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
        }
        cb(null, uploadDir);
    },
    filename: (req, file, cb) => {
        const uniqueName = `${uuidv4()}${path.extname(file.originalname)}`;
        cb(null, uniqueName);
    }
});

const upload = multer({
    storage,
    limits: { fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024 }, // 10MB limit
    fileFilter: (req, file, cb) => {
        const allowedTypes = /jpeg|jpg|png|gif|webp/;
        const extname = allowedTypes.test(path.extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase());
        const mimetype = allowedTypes.test(file.mimetype);
        if (extname && mimetype) {
            cb(null, true);
        } else {
            cb(new Error('Only image files are allowed'));
        }
    }
});

// Database file path
const DB_FILE = './posters.json';

// Helper function to read database
function readDatabase() {
    try {
        if (fs.existsSync(DB_FILE)) {
            const data = fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, 'utf8');
            return JSON.parse(data || '[]');
        }
        return [];
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error reading database:', error);
        return [];
    }
}

// Helper function to write database
function writeDatabase(data) {
    try {
        fs.writeFileSync(DB_FILE, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error writing database:', error);
        return false;
    }
}

// Create thumbnail
async function createThumbnail(imagePath, thumbnailPath) {
    try {
        await sharp(imagePath)
            .resize(300, 300, { fit: 'inside', withoutEnlargement: true })
            .jpeg({ quality: 80 })
            .toFile(thumbnailPath);
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error creating thumbnail:', error);
        return false;
    }
}

// API Routes

// Get all posters
app.get('/api/posters', (req, res) => {
    const posters = readDatabase();
    res.json(posters);
});

// Get single poster
app.get('/api/posters/:id', (req, res) => {
    const posters = readDatabase();
    const poster = posters.find(p => p.id === req.params.id);
    if (poster) {
        res.json(poster);
    } else {
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'Poster not found' });
    }
});

// Create new poster
app.post('/api/posters', upload.single('image'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
        if (!req.file) {
            return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No image uploaded' });
        }

        const { title, artist, description, layers } = req.body;
        
        // Create thumbnails directory if it doesn't exist
        const thumbnailDir = './uploads/thumbnails';
        if (!fs.existsSync(thumbnailDir)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(thumbnailDir, { recursive: true });
        }

        // Create thumbnail
        const thumbnailPath = `${thumbnailDir}/${req.file.filename}`;
        await createThumbnail(req.file.path, thumbnailPath);

        const newPoster = {
            id: uuidv4(),
            title: title || 'Untitled',
            artist: artist || 'Unknown',
            description: description || '',
            image: `/uploads/${req.file.filename}`,
            thumbnail: `/uploads/thumbnails/${req.file.filename}`,
            layers: layers ? JSON.parse(layers) : [],
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };

        const posters = readDatabase();
        posters.push(newPoster);
        writeDatabase(posters);

        res.status(201).json(newPoster);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error creating poster:', error);
        res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to create poster' });
    }
});

// Update poster
app.put('/api/posters/:id', upload.single('image'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
        const posters = readDatabase();
        const index = posters.findIndex(p => p.id === req.params.id);
        
        if (index === -1) {
            return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Poster not found' });
        }

        const { title, artist, description, layers } = req.body;
        const updatedPoster = { ...posters[index] };

        if (title) updatedPoster.title = title;
        if (artist) updatedPoster.artist = artist;
        if (description !== undefined) updatedPoster.description = description;
        if (layers) updatedPoster.layers = JSON.parse(layers);

        if (req.file) {
            // Delete old image
            if (posters[index].image) {
                const oldImagePath = `.${posters[index].image}`;
                if (fs.existsSync(oldImagePath)) {
                    fs.unlinkSync(oldImagePath);
                }
            }
            if (posters[index].thumbnail) {
                const oldThumbPath = `.${posters[index].thumbnail}`;
                if (fs.existsSync(oldThumbPath)) {
                    fs.unlinkSync(oldThumbPath);
                }
            }

            // Create new thumbnail
            const thumbnailDir = './uploads/thumbnails';
            const thumbnailPath = `${thumbnailDir}/${req.file.filename}`;
            await createThumbnail(req.file.path, thumbnailPath);

            updatedPoster.image = `/uploads/${req.file.filename}`;
            updatedPoster.thumbnail = `/uploads/thumbnails/${req.file.filename}`;
        }

        updatedPoster.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        posters[index] = updatedPoster;
        writeDatabase(posters);

        res.json(updatedPoster);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error updating poster:', error);
        res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to update poster' });
    }
});

// Delete poster
app.delete('/api/posters/:id', (req, res) => {
    try {
        const posters = readDatabase();
        const index = posters.findIndex(p => p.id === req.params.id);
        
        if (index === -1) {
            return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Poster not found' });
        }

        // Delete image files
        if (posters[index].image) {
            const imagePath = `.${posters[index].image}`;
            if (fs.existsSync(imagePath)) {
                fs.unlinkSync(imagePath);
            }
        }
        if (posters[index].thumbnail) {
            const thumbPath = `.${posters[index].thumbnail}`;
            if (fs.existsSync(thumbPath)) {
                fs.unlinkSync(thumbPath);
            }
        }

        posters.splice(index, 1);
        writeDatabase(posters);

        res.json({ message: 'Poster deleted successfully' });
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error deleting poster:', error);
        res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to delete poster' });
    }
});

// Upload layer image
app.post('/api/layers/upload', upload.single('layer'), (req, res) => {
    try {
        if (!req.file) {
            return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No file uploaded' });
        }
        res.json({ 
            url: `/uploads/${req.file.filename}`,
            filename: req.file.filename 
        });
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error uploading layer:', error);
        res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to upload layer' });
    }
});

// Serve static files from uploads
app.use('/uploads', express.static('uploads'));

// Serve static files from assets
app.use('/assets', express.static('assets'));

// Start server
app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`🚀 Server running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    console.log(`📁 Static files served from current directory`);
    console.log(`📸 Uploads directory: ./uploads`);
});

```

```
function handleGetPosters($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT * FROM posters ORDER BY upload_date DESC");
        $posters = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Decode layers_data for all posters
        foreach ($posters as &$poster) {
            if (isset($poster['layers_data']) && !empty($poster['layers_data'])) {
                $poster['layers'] = json_decode($poster['layers_data'], true);
                unset($poster['layers_data']);
            } else {
                $poster['layers'] = [];
            }
        }
        
        jsonResponse($posters);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Database error in handleGetPosters: " . $e->getMessage());
        jsonResponse(['message' => 'Database error: ' . $e->getMessage()], 500);
    }
}
```

    $error = "PHP Error [$errno]: $errstr in $errfile on line $errline";
    error_log($error);
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['message' => 'Server error', 'error' => $error]);

});

});

// Setup animation toggles for all layers
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

function setupARTrackingSettings() {
    console.log('⚙️ setupARTrackingSettings() called');
    console.log('📝 DOM Content-Type:', document.contentType);
    console.log('📍 Current page:', window.location.href);
    
    // Test localStorage availability
    try {
        localStorage.setItem('__test__', 'test');
        localStorage.removeItem('__test__');
        console.log('✅ localStorage is available');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('❌ localStorage is NOT available:', e);
        alert('⚠️ localStorage niet beschikbaar! Settings kunnen niet worden opgeslagen.');
        return;
    }
    
    // Load saved settings from localStorage
    console.log('🔍 Loaded settings from localStorage:', {
        ar_filterMinCF: localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF'),
        ar_filterBeta: localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta'),
        ar_warmupTolerance: localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance'),
        ar_missTolerance: localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance')
    });
    
    const savedSettings = {
        filterMinCF: parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF') || '0.003'),
        filterBeta: parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta') || '0.025'),
        warmupTolerance: parseInt(localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance') || '5'),
        missTolerance: parseInt(localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance') || '5')
    };
    
    console.log('💾 Parsed settings:', savedSettings);
    
    // Set slider values
    const filterMinCFSlider = document.getElementById('filterMinCF-slider');
    const filterBetaSlider = document.getElementById('filterBeta-slider');
    const warmupToleranceSlider = document.getElementById('warmupTolerance-slider');
    const missToleranceSlider = document.getElementById('missTolerance-slider');
    
    console.log('🔍 SLIDER ELEMENTS FOUND:');
    console.log('   filterMinCFSlider:', filterMinCFSlider ? '✅ FOUND' : '❌ NOT FOUND');
    console.log('   filterBetaSlider:', filterBetaSlider ? '✅ FOUND' : '❌ NOT FOUND');
    console.log('   warmupToleranceSlider:', warmupToleranceSlider ? '✅ FOUND' : '❌ NOT FOUND');
    console.log('   missToleranceSlider:', missToleranceSlider ? '✅ FOUND' : '❌ NOT FOUND');
    
    if (filterMinCFSlider) {
        filterMinCFSlider.value = savedSettings.filterMinCF;
        document.getElementById('filterMinCF-display').textContent = savedSettings.filterMinCF;
        filterMinCFSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            console.log('📊 filterMinCF slider moved to:', e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('filterMinCF-display').textContent = e.target.value;
        });
    }
    
    if (filterBetaSlider) {
        filterBetaSlider.value = savedSettings.filterBeta;
        document.getElementById('filterBeta-display').textContent = savedSettings.filterBeta;
        filterBetaSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            console.log('📊 filterBeta slider moved to:', e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('filterBeta-display').textContent = e.target.value;
        });
    }
    
    if (warmupToleranceSlider) {
        warmupToleranceSlider.value = savedSettings.warmupTolerance;
        document.getElementById('warmupTolerance-display').textContent = savedSettings.warmupTolerance;
        warmupToleranceSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            console.log('📊 warmupTolerance slider moved to:', e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('warmupTolerance-display').textContent = e.target.value;
        });
    }
    
    if (missToleranceSlider) {
        missToleranceSlider.value = savedSettings.missTolerance;
        document.getElementById('missTolerance-display').textContent = savedSettings.missTolerance;
        missToleranceSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            console.log('📊 missTolerance slider moved to:', e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('missTolerance-display').textContent = e.target.value;
        });
    }
    
    // Save button
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-ar-settings-btn');
    if (saveBtn) {
        console.log('🔧 Save button found, attaching event listener');
        saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            console.log('🖱️ SAVE BUTTON CLICKED');
            
            const newSettings = {
                filterMinCF: parseFloat(filterMinCFSlider.value),
                filterBeta: parseFloat(filterBetaSlider.value),
                warmupTolerance: parseInt(warmupToleranceSlider.value),
                missTolerance: parseInt(missToleranceSlider.value)
            };
            
            console.log('💾 SAVING AR TRACKING SETTINGS TO LOCALSTORAGE:');
            console.log('   filterMinCF:', newSettings.filterMinCF, typeof newSettings.filterMinCF);
            console.log('   filterBeta:', newSettings.filterBeta, typeof newSettings.filterBeta);
            console.log('   warmupTolerance:', newSettings.warmupTolerance, typeof newSettings.warmupTolerance);
            console.log('   missTolerance:', newSettings.missTolerance, typeof newSettings.missTolerance);
            
            try {
                // Save to localStorage
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterMinCF', newSettings.filterMinCF.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterBeta', newSettings.filterBeta.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_warmupTolerance', newSettings.warmupTolerance.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_missTolerance', newSettings.missTolerance.toString());
                
                console.log('✅ IMMEDIATELY AFTER SETITEM, verifying what was stored:');
                console.log('   ar_filterMinCF:', localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF'), 'type:', typeof localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF'));
                console.log('   ar_filterBeta:', localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta'), 'type:', typeof localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta'));
                console.log('   ar_warmupTolerance:', localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance'), 'type:', typeof localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance'));
                console.log('   ar_missTolerance:', localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance'), 'type:', typeof localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance'));
                
                // Also save to backend as backup (for cross-domain access)
                console.log('📤 Also saving to backend API as backup...');
                fetch(`${API_URL}/settings/ar-tracking`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(newSettings)
                })
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    console.log('✅ Backend saved AR settings:', data);
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    console.warn('⚠️ Could not save to backend:', err);
                });
                
                const statusEl = document.getElementById('ar-settings-status');
                if (statusEl) {
                    statusEl.textContent = '✅ Settings opgeslagen! (herlaad AR view om toe te passen)';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        statusEl.textContent = '';
                    }, 3000);
                }
                
                console.log('📊 ✅ AR Tracking settings saved successfully to localStorage');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('❌ ERROR saving to localStorage:', error);
                const statusEl = document.getElementById('ar-settings-status');
                if (statusEl) {
                    statusEl.textContent = '❌ Fout bij opslaan: ' + error.message;
                }
            }
        });
    } else {
        console.warn('⚠️ Save button NOT found with id="save-ar-settings-btn"');
    }
}

```
// Add MindAR image targets
function addMindARTargets(scene) {
    console.log('📌 Adding MindAR image target...');
    
    // Get the first poster to use its layers
    const poster = window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0 ? window.allPosters[0] : null;
    console.log('📋 Using poster for AR layers:', poster ? poster.title : 'NONE');
    
    // Add lights to scene
    const ambientLight = document.createElement('a-light');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('type', 'ambient');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('color', '#FFFFFF');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('intensity', '1');
    scene.appendChild(ambientLight);
    
    const directionalLight = document.createElement('a-light');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('type', 'directional');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('color', '#FFFFFF');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('intensity', '0.5');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('position', '1 1 1');
    scene.appendChild(directionalLight);
    
    // Create MindAR target entity
    const target = document.createElement('a-entity');
    target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
    target.setAttribute('id', 'ar-target-0');
    target.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    
    // Determine layer positions based on zoom level
    // Ultrawide (0.5x) needs much closer positions because perspective is wider
    const isUltrawide = window.cameraZoomLevel <= 0.6;
    
    // Create layers dynamically from poster data
    let layerCount = 0;
    
    if (poster && poster.layers) {
        console.log('🎨 Creating layers from poster data:', poster.layers);
        
        // Loop through all 8 possible layers
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerKey = `layer_${i}`;
            const layerData = poster.layers[layerKey];
            
            // Skip if no layer data or no filename
            if (!layerData || !layerData.filename) {
                console.log(`⏭️ Layer ${i}: skipped (no file)`);
                continue;
            }
            
            layerCount++;
            console.log(`🖼️ Layer ${i}:`, layerData);
            
            // Calculate Z position - use poster data, scale for ultrawide if needed
            let zPos = parseFloat(layerData.z) || (i * 0.05);
            if (isUltrawide) {
                zPos = zPos * 0.3; // Scale down Z for ultrawide
            }
            
            // Create layer plane
            const layer = document.createElement('a-plane');
            layer.setAttribute('id', `ar-layer-${i}`);
            layer.setAttribute('position', `0 0 ${zPos}`);
            layer.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
            layer.setAttribute('width', '1.1');
            layer.setAttribute('height', '1.54');
            layer.setAttribute('scale', '1.0 1.0 1.0');
            
            // Build image path - layers are stored in uploads/ar-layers/
            const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
            console.log(`📁 Layer ${i} image path:`, imagePath);
            
            // Apply exclusion filter if enabled
            const shaderType = layerData.exclusion_filter ? 'standard' : 'flat';
            const blendMode = layerData.exclusion_filter ? 'blending: additive;' : '';
            layer.setAttribute('material', `src: ${imagePath}; shader: ${shaderType}; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double; ${blendMode}`);
            layer.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
            
            // Add animation if configured (anim_x, anim_y, anim_z > 0)
            const animX = parseFloat(layerData.anim_x) || 0;
            const animY = parseFloat(layerData.anim_y) || 0;
            const animZ = parseFloat(layerData.anim_z) || 0;
            const animDuration = parseInt(layerData.anim_duration) || 2000;
            
            if (animX > 0 || animY > 0 || animZ > 0) {
                console.log(`🎬 Layer ${i}: Adding animation (X:${animX}, Y:${animY}, Z:${animZ}, dur:${animDuration}ms)`);
                
                // Scale animation for ultrawide
                const scaleFactor = isUltrawide ? 0.3 : 1.0;
                
                if (animX > 0) {
                    const range = animX * scaleFactor;
                    layer.setAttribute('animation__x', `property: position.x; from: ${-range}; to: ${range}; dur: ${animDuration}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                }
                if (animY > 0) {
                    const range = animY * scaleFactor;
                    layer.setAttribute('animation__y', `property: position.y; from: ${-range}; to: ${range}; dur: ${animDuration * 1.1}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                }
                if (animZ > 0) {
                    const range = animZ * scaleFactor;
                    layer.setAttribute('animation__z', `property: position.z; from: ${zPos - range}; to: ${zPos + range}; dur: ${animDuration * 1.2}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                }
            }
            
            target.appendChild(layer);
        }
    }
    
    // Fallback: if no layers found, show a warning
    if (layerCount === 0) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No AR layers found for poster! AR overlay will be empty.');
    } else {
        console.log(`✅ Created ${layerCount} AR layers from poster data`);
    }
    
    scene.appendChild(target);
```

    const ambientLight = document.createElement('a-light');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('type', 'ambient');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('color', '#FFFFFF');
    ambientLight.setAttribute('intensity', '1');
    scene.appendChild(ambientLight);
    
    const directionalLight = document.createElement('a-light');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('type', 'directional');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('color', '#FFFFFF');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('intensity', '0.5');
    directionalLight.setAttribute('position', '1 1 1');
    scene.appendChild(directionalLight);
    
    // Create MindAR target entity
    const target = document.createElement('a-entity');
    target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
    target.setAttribute('id', 'ar-target-0');
    target.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    
    // Determine layer positions based on zoom level
    // Ultrawide (0.5x) needs much closer positions because perspective is wider
    const isUltrawide = window.cameraZoomLevel <= 0.6;
    let layer1Pos, layer2Pos, layer3Pos, layer1Scale, layer2Scale, layer3Scale;
    
    if (isUltrawide) {
        console.log('🎯 Ultrawide lens detected - using scaled-down layer positions');
        // Ultrawide positions (much closer to poster)
        layer1Pos = '0 0 0.001';   // On poster surface
        layer2Pos = '0 0 0.03';    // 3cm away (was 15cm)
        layer3Pos = '0 0 0.05';    // 5cm away (was 25cm)
        layer1Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer2Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer3Scale = '1.05 1.05 1.05';
    } else {
        console.log('📷 Standard lens detected - using normal layer positions');
        // Standard positions
        layer1Pos = '0 0 0.001';   // On poster surface
        layer2Pos = '0 0 0.15';    // 15cm away
        layer3Pos = '0 0 0.25';    // 25cm away
        layer1Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer2Scale = '1.0 1.0 1.0';
        layer3Scale = '1.05 1.05 1.05';
    }
    
    // Layer 1: Image on poster surface - slightly larger to cover edges
    const layer1 = document.createElement('a-plane');
    layer1.setAttribute('id', 'ar-layer-1');
    layer1.setAttribute('position', layer1Pos);
    layer1.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
    layer1.setAttribute('width', '1.1');
    layer1.setAttribute('height', '1.54');
    layer1.setAttribute('scale', layer1Scale);
    layer1.setAttribute('material', 'src: img/Drone_1.png; shader: flat; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double');
    layer1.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    
    // Layer 2: Image hovering in space
    const layer2 = document.createElement('a-plane');
    layer2.setAttribute('id', 'ar-layer-2');
    layer2.setAttribute('position', layer2Pos);
    layer2.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
    layer2.setAttribute('width', '1.1');
    layer2.setAttribute('height', '1.54');
    layer2.setAttribute('scale', layer2Scale);
    layer2.setAttribute('material', 'src: img/Drone_2.png; shader: flat; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double');
    layer2.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    
    // Layer 3: Image hovering furthest with subtle, slow floating animation
    const layer3 = document.createElement('a-plane');
    layer3.setAttribute('id', 'ar-layer-3');
    layer3.setAttribute('position', layer3Pos);
    layer3.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
    layer3.setAttribute('width', '1.15');
    layer3.setAttribute('height', '1.61');
    layer3.setAttribute('scale', layer3Scale);
    layer3.setAttribute('material', 'src: img/Drone_3.png; shader: flat; transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5; side: double');
    layer3.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
    
    // Very slow, subtle animations - 6-8 second cycles for smooth breathing effect
    // Animation ranges scaled for ultrawide
    const animRangeX = isUltrawide ? 0.003 : 0.01;
    const animRangeY = isUltrawide ? 0.0015 : 0.005;
    const animRangeZ = isUltrawide ? 0.002 : 0.01;
    
    const layer3ZValue = parseFloat(layer3Pos.split(' ')[2]);
    layer3.setAttribute('animation__x', `property: position.x; from: ${-animRangeX}; to: ${animRangeX}; dur: 6000; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
    layer3.setAttribute('animation__y', `property: position.y; from: ${-animRangeY}; to: ${animRangeY}; dur: 7000; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
    layer3.setAttribute('animation__z', `property: position.z; from: ${layer3ZValue - animRangeZ}; to: ${layer3ZValue + animRangeZ}; dur: 8000; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
    layer3.setAttribute('animation__scale', 'property: scale; from: 0.99 0.99 0.99; to: 1.01 1.01 1.01; dur: 8000; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad');
    
    console.log('🎨 Layer 3: Slow breathing animation (6-8s cycles, scaled for zoom level)');
    
    target.appendChild(layer1);
    target.appendChild(layer2);
    target.appendChild(layer3);
    scene.appendChild(target);

        // Switch to AR view
        console.log('🔄 Switching to AR view...');

        console.log('✅ AR view displayed');
        
        // Get the scene element
        const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
        
        // IMPORTANT: Set the AR marker BEFORE scene fully initializes
        // MindAR reads the mindar-image attribute only on startup
        if (window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0) {
            const poster = window.allPosters[0];
            if (poster.ar_marker) {
                const markerPath = poster.ar_marker + '.mind';
                console.log('🎯 Pre-setting AR marker to:', markerPath);
                scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${markerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no; maxTrack: 1; filterMinCF: 0.003; filterBeta: 0.025; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 5;`);
            }
        }
        
        // Add a timeout check for scene loading
        const loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            console.warn('⚠️ Scene taking too long to load, checking status...');
            if (!scene.hasLoaded) {
                console.error('❌ Scene failed to load within timeout');
                alert('AR initialization timeout. Please check camera permissions and try again.');
            }
        }, 10000);
        
        if (scene.hasLoaded) {
            clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
            initializeARScene();

                initializeARScene();
            });
        }
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ AR initialization failed:', error);
        showDesktopView();
        loadPosters();
        setupModal();
    }

function handleDeletePoster($db, $id) {
    if (!isAdmin()) jsonResponse(['message' => 'Niet geautoriseerd'], 401);
    
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM posters WHERE id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$id]);
    $poster = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    
    if (!$poster) jsonResponse(['message' => 'Poster niet gevonden'], 404);
    
    // Delete files
    @unlink(UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $poster['jpeg_filename']);
    @unlink(UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $poster['pdf_medium_filename']);
    @unlink(UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $poster['pdf_large_filename']);
    @unlink(THUMBNAILS_DIR . '/' . basename($poster['thumbnail']));
    
    // Delete DB entry
    $db->prepare("DELETE FROM posters WHERE id = ?")->execute([$id]);
    
    logAdminActivity('DELETE_POSTER', "ID: $id");
    jsonResponse(['success' => true]);
}

function handleUpdatePoster($db, $id) {
    if (!isAdmin()) {
        jsonResponse(['message' => 'Niet geautoriseerd'], 401);
    }
    
    // Get existing poster
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM posters WHERE id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$id]);
    $poster = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    
    if (!$poster) {
        jsonResponse(['message' => 'Poster niet gevonden'], 404);
    }
    
    try {
        // Get form data (use existing values as defaults)
        $title = $_POST['title'] ?? $poster['title'];
        $description = $_POST['description'] ?? $poster['description'];
        $latitude = isset($_POST['latitude']) && $_POST['latitude'] !== '' ? (float)$_POST['latitude'] : $poster['latitude'];
        $longitude = isset($_POST['longitude']) && $_POST['longitude'] !== '' ? (float)$_POST['longitude'] : $poster['longitude'];
        $locationDescription = $_POST['location_description'] ?? $poster['location_description'];
        $artikelLink = $_POST['artikel_link'] ?? $poster['artikel_link'];
        $photographerCredit = $_POST['photographer_credit'] ?? $poster['photographer_credit'];
        
        // File paths (keep existing unless new file uploaded)
        $jpegFilename = $poster['jpeg_filename'];
        $pdfMediumFilename = $poster['pdf_medium_filename'];
        $pdfLargeFilename = $poster['pdf_large_filename'];
        $thumbnailPath = $poster['thumbnail'];
        $arMarkerPath = $poster['ar_marker'];
        
        // Handle new JPEG upload
        if (isset($_FILES['jpeg']) && $_FILES['jpeg']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            $validation = validateUploadedFile($_FILES['jpeg'], ['image/jpeg'], 52428800);
            if (!$validation['valid']) {
                jsonResponse(['message' => 'JPEG: ' . $validation['message']], 400);
            }
            // Delete old file
            @unlink(UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $poster['jpeg_filename']);
            @unlink(THUMBNAILS_DIR . '/' . basename($poster['thumbnail']));
            
            $jpegFilename = $id . '_' . basename($_FILES['jpeg']['name']);
            move_uploaded_file($_FILES['jpeg']['tmp_name'], UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $jpegFilename);
            
            $thumbnailFilename = 'thumb_' . $jpegFilename;
            createThumbnail(UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $jpegFilename, THUMBNAILS_DIR . '/' . $thumbnailFilename);
            $thumbnailPath = '/uploads/thumbnails/' . $thumbnailFilename;
        }
        
        // Handle new PDF Medium upload
        if (isset($_FILES['pdfMedium']) && $_FILES['pdfMedium']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            $validation = validateUploadedFile($_FILES['pdfMedium'], ['application/pdf'], 104857600);
            if (!$validation['valid']) {
                jsonResponse(['message' => 'PDF Medium: ' . $validation['message']], 400);
            }
            @unlink(UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $poster['pdf_medium_filename']);
            $pdfMediumFilename = $id . '_medium.pdf';
            move_uploaded_file($_FILES['pdfMedium']['tmp_name'], UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $pdfMediumFilename);
        }
        
        // Handle new PDF Large upload
        if (isset($_FILES['pdfLarge']) && $_FILES['pdfLarge']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            $validation = validateUploadedFile($_FILES['pdfLarge'], ['application/pdf'], 104857600);
            if (!$validation['valid']) {
                jsonResponse(['message' => 'PDF Large: ' . $validation['message']], 400);
            }
            @unlink(UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $poster['pdf_large_filename']);
            $pdfLargeFilename = $id . '_large.pdf';
            move_uploaded_file($_FILES['pdfLarge']['tmp_name'], UPLOADS_DIR . '/' . $pdfLargeFilename);
        }
        
        // Handle new AR marker upload
        if (isset($_FILES['ar_marker_file']) && $_FILES['ar_marker_file']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            $validation = validateUploadedFile($_FILES['ar_marker_file'], ['application/octet-stream', 'application/json'], 10485760);
            if (!$validation['valid']) {
                jsonResponse(['message' => 'AR Marker: ' . $validation['message']], 400);
            }
            
            $mindDir = __DIR__ . '/../assets/nft/' . $id;
            if (!file_exists($mindDir)) mkdir($mindDir, 0755, true);
            
            // Delete old .mind file if exists
            $oldMindFile = $mindDir . '/' . $id . '.mind';
            @unlink($oldMindFile);
            
            $mindFilename = $id . '.mind';
            move_uploaded_file($_FILES['ar_marker_file']['tmp_name'], $mindDir . '/' . $mindFilename);
            $arMarkerPath = 'assets/nft/' . $id . '/' . $id;
        }
        
        // Handle layer updates
        $existingLayers = json_decode($poster['layers_data'] ?? '{}', true) ?: [];
        $layersData = [];
        
        for ($i = 1; $i <= 8; $i++) {
            $existingLayer = $existingLayers["layer_$i"] ?? [];
            
            $layerData = [
                'z' => isset($_POST["layer_{$i}_z"]) ? (float)$_POST["layer_{$i}_z"] : ($existingLayer['z'] ?? 0),
                'anim_x' => isset($_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_x"]) ? (float)$_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_x"] : ($existingLayer['anim_x'] ?? 0),
                'anim_y' => isset($_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_y"]) ? (float)$_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_y"] : ($existingLayer['anim_y'] ?? 0),
                'anim_z' => isset($_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_z"]) ? (float)$_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_z"] : ($existingLayer['anim_z'] ?? 0),
                'anim_duration' => isset($_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_duration"]) ? (int)$_POST["layer_{$i}_anim_duration"] : ($existingLayer['anim_duration'] ?? 0),
                'exclusion_filter' => isset($_POST["layer_{$i}_exclusion"]) ? ((int)$_POST["layer_{$i}_exclusion"] === 1) : ($existingLayer['exclusion_filter'] ?? false),
                'filename' => $existingLayer['filename'] ?? null
            ];
            
            // Handle new layer image upload
            if (isset($_FILES["layer_{$i}_image"]) && $_FILES["layer_{$i}_image"]['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                // Delete old layer file
                if ($existingLayer['filename']) {
                    @unlink(AR_LAYERS_DIR . '/' . $existingLayer['filename']);
                }
                
                $layerFilename = $id . "_layer_{$i}.png";
                move_uploaded_file($_FILES["layer_{$i}_image"]['tmp_name'], AR_LAYERS_DIR . '/' . $layerFilename);
                $layerData['filename'] = $layerFilename;
            }
            
            $layersData["layer_$i"] = $layerData;
        }
        
        // Update database
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE posters SET 
                title = ?, description = ?, jpeg_filename = ?, pdf_medium_filename = ?, pdf_large_filename = ?,
                thumbnail = ?, latitude = ?, longitude = ?, location_description = ?, 
                artikel_link = ?, photographer_credit = ?, ar_marker = ?, layers_data = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        
        $stmt->execute([
            $title, $description, $jpegFilename, $pdfMediumFilename, $pdfLargeFilename,
            $thumbnailPath, $latitude, $longitude, $locationDescription,
            $artikelLink, $photographerCredit, $arMarkerPath, json_encode($layersData), $id
        ]);
        
        logAdminActivity('UPDATE_POSTER', "$title (ID: $id)");
        
        // Return updated poster
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM posters WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        jsonResponse(['success' => true, 'poster' => $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        logAdminActivity('UPDATE_FAILED', $e->getMessage());
        jsonResponse(['message' => 'Server fout: ' . $e->getMessage()], 500);
    }
}
```

// Admin.js - Client-side JavaScript voor het admin dashboard

// Layer Configuration - centraal beheer van layers
const LAYER_CONFIG = {
    maxLayers: 8,
    defaultLayers: [
        { num: 1, name: 'Base - op poster oppervlak', defaultZ: 0.000 },
        { num: 2, name: '1cm boven poster', defaultZ: 0.010 },
        { num: 3, name: '4cm boven poster', defaultZ: 0.040 },
        { num: 4, name: '10cm boven poster', defaultZ: 0.100 },
        { num: 5, name: 'Extra layer 5', defaultZ: 0.150 },
        { num: 6, name: 'Extra layer 6', defaultZ: 0.200 },
        { num: 7, name: 'Extra layer 7', defaultZ: 0.250 },
        { num: 8, name: 'Extra layer 8', defaultZ: 0.300 }
    ]
};

// Active layers per form (not stored in localStorage, reset on page load)
let uploadFormLayers = [1]; // Start with just layer 1
let editFormLayers = [1];

// Get active layers for a specific form
function getActiveLayers(isEditForm = false) {
    return isEditForm ? editFormLayers : uploadFormLayers;
}

// Set active layers for a specific form
function setActiveLayers(layerNums, isEditForm = false) {
    if (isEditForm) {
        editFormLayers = layerNums;
    } else {
        uploadFormLayers = layerNums;
    }
}

// Generate HTML for a single layer
function generateLayerHTML(layerNum, isEditForm = false) {
    const prefix = isEditForm ? 'edit-' : '';
    const config = LAYER_CONFIG.defaultLayers.find(l => l.num === layerNum);
    const layerName = config ? config.name : `Layer ${layerNum}`;
    const defaultZ = config ? config.defaultZ : 0;
```

```
// Admin.js - Client-side JavaScript voor het admin dashboard

// Layer Configuration - centraal beheer van layers
const LAYER_CONFIG = {
    maxLayers: 8,
    defaultLayers: [
        { num: 1, name: 'Base - op poster oppervlak', defaultZ: 0.000 },
        { num: 2, name: '1cm boven poster', defaultZ: 0.010 },
        { num: 3, name: '4cm boven poster', defaultZ: 0.040 },
        { num: 4, name: '10cm boven poster', defaultZ: 0.100 },
        { num: 5, name: 'Extra layer 5', defaultZ: 0.150 },
        { num: 6, name: 'Extra layer 6', defaultZ: 0.200 },
        { num: 7, name: 'Extra layer 7', defaultZ: 0.250 },
        { num: 8, name: 'Extra layer 8', defaultZ: 0.300 }
    ]
};

// Get active layers from localStorage (defaults to all 8)
function getActiveLayers() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('active_layers');
    if (saved) {
        return JSON.parse(saved);
    }
    return LAYER_CONFIG.defaultLayers.map(l => l.num); // [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]
}

// Save active layers
function setActiveLayers(layerNums) {
    localStorage.setItem('active_layers', JSON.stringify(layerNums));
}

// Generate HTML for a single layer
function generateLayerHTML(layerNum, isEditForm = false) {
    const prefix = isEditForm ? 'edit-' : '';
    const config = LAYER_CONFIG.defaultLayers.find(l => l.num === layerNum);
    const layerName = config ? config.name : `Layer ${layerNum}`;
    const defaultZ = config ? config.defaultZ : 0;
```

```
function addLayer() {
    const activeLayers = getActiveLayers();
    if (activeLayers.length >= LAYER_CONFIG.maxLayers) {
        alert(`Maximum van ${LAYER_CONFIG.maxLayers} lagen bereikt`);
        return;
    }
    
    // Find next available layer number
    let nextNum = 1;
    while (activeLayers.includes(nextNum)) {
        nextNum++;
    }
    
    activeLayers.push(nextNum);
    activeLayers.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    setActiveLayers(activeLayers);
    renderLayers(false);
}

function removeLayer(layerNum, isEditForm = false) {
    const activeLayers = getActiveLayers();
    
    // Minimum 1 layer required
    if (activeLayers.length <= 1) {
        alert('Er moet minimaal 1 laag zijn');
        return;
    }
    
    const index = activeLayers.indexOf(layerNum);
    if (index > -1) {
        activeLayers.splice(index, 1);
        setActiveLayers(activeLayers);
        renderLayers(isEditForm);
    }
}

function setupRemoveLayerButtons(isEditForm = false) {
    const container = document.getElementById(isEditForm ? 'edit-layers-container' : 'layers-container');
    if (!container) return;
    
    container.querySelectorAll('.remove-layer-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const layerNum = parseInt(e.target.dataset.layer);
            if (confirm(`Weet je zeker dat je laag ${layerNum} wilt verwijderen?`)) {
                removeLayer(layerNum, isEditForm);
            }
        });
    });
}

// Initialize layers on page load
```

// Dynamic Layer Management
function renderLayers(isEditForm = false) {
    const containerEl = document.getElementById(isEditForm ? 'edit-layers-container' : 'layers-container');
    if (!containerEl) return;
    
    const activeLayers = getActiveLayers();
    containerEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    activeLayers.forEach(layerNum => {
        const layerHTML = generateLayerHTML(layerNum, isEditForm);
        containerEl.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', layerHTML);
        
        // Setup animation toggle for this layer
        setupLayerAnimationToggle(layerNum, isEditForm);
    });
    
    // Setup remove layer buttons
    setupRemoveLayerButtons(isEditForm);
    
    // Update counter
    const counterEl = document.getElementById(isEditForm ? 'edit-layer-count-info' : 'layer-count-info');
    if (counterEl) counterEl.textContent = `Aantal lagen: ${activeLayers.length}`;
}
```

// Dynamic Layer Management
function renderLayers(isEditForm = false) {

    const activeLayers = getActiveLayers();
    containerEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    activeLayers.forEach(layerNum => {

}

        alert(`Maximum van ${LAYER_CONFIG.maxLayers} lagen bereikt`);
        return;
    }
    
    // Find next available layer number
    let nextNum = 1;
    while (activeLayers.includes(nextNum)) {
        nextNum++;
    }
    
    activeLayers.push(nextNum);
    activeLayers.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    setActiveLayers(activeLayers);
    renderLayers(false);
}
```

async function openEditModal(posterId) {
    try {
        // Fetch poster data
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters/${posterId}`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Poster niet gevonden');
        
        const poster = await response.json();
        
        // Populate form
        document.getElementById('edit-poster-id').value = poster.id;
        document.getElementById('edit-title').value = poster.title || '';
        document.getElementById('edit-description').value = poster.description || '';
        
        // Combine lat/lng into single coordinates field
        const lat = poster.latitude || '';
        const lng = poster.longitude || '';
        const coordinatesValue = (lat && lng) ? `${lat}, ${lng}` : '';
        document.getElementById('edit-coordinates').value = coordinatesValue;
        
        document.getElementById('edit-location').value = poster.location_description || '';
        document.getElementById('edit-artikel-link').value = poster.artikel_link || '';
        document.getElementById('edit-photographer').value = poster.photographer_credit || '';
        
        // Show current .mind file
        const markerInfo = document.getElementById('edit-ar-marker-current');
        if (markerInfo) {
            if (poster.ar_marker) {
                const filename = poster.ar_marker.split('/').pop() + '.mind';
                markerInfo.textContent = `Huidig: ${filename}`;
                markerInfo.style.color = '#27ae60';
            } else {
                markerInfo.textContent = 'Geen AR marker gekoppeld';
                markerInfo.style.color = '#e74c3c';
            }
        }
        
        // Determine which layers the poster has
        let posterLayers = [];
        if (poster.layers) {
            for (let i = 1; i <= LAYER_CONFIG.maxLayers; i++) {
                if (poster.layers[`layer_${i}`]) {
                    posterLayers.push(i);
                }
            }
        }
        // Default to layer 1 if no layers exist
        if (posterLayers.length === 0) {
            posterLayers = [1];
        }
        
        // Set active layers based on poster data
        setActiveLayers(posterLayers);
        
        // Render dynamic layers for edit form
        renderLayers(true);
        
        // Populate layer data if available (iterate over active layers only)
        const activeLayers = getActiveLayers();
        for (const layerNum of activeLayers) {
            const layerData = poster.layers ? poster.layers[`layer_${layerNum}`] : null;
            
            if (layerData) {
                // Set z-position
                const zInput = document.getElementById(`edit-layer-${layerNum}-z`);
                if (zInput) zInput.value = layerData.z || LAYER_CONFIG.defaultLayers.find(l => l.number === layerNum)?.defaultZ.toFixed(3) || '0.000';
                
                // Set exclusion filter checkbox
                const exclusionCheckbox = document.getElementById(`edit-layer-${layerNum}-exclusion`);
                if (exclusionCheckbox) {
                    exclusionCheckbox.checked = layerData.exclusion_filter || false;
                }
                
                // Check if has animation data (any non-zero anim value)
                const hasAnimation = layerData.anim_x || layerData.anim_y || layerData.anim_z || 
                                    layerData.anim_rot_x || layerData.anim_rot_y || layerData.anim_rot_z ||
                                    (layerData.anim_scale && layerData.anim_scale !== 1.0) ||
                                    (layerData.anim_opacity && layerData.anim_opacity !== 1.0) ||
                                    (layerData.anim_duration && layerData.anim_duration !== 0);
                
                // Set animation toggle
                const animToggle = document.getElementById(`edit-layer-${layerNum}-enable-anim`);
                if (animToggle) {
                    animToggle.checked = hasAnimation;
                    // Show/hide animation container
                    const animContainer = document.getElementById(`edit-layer-${layerNum}-anim-container`);
                    if (animContainer) {
                        animContainer.style.display = hasAnimation ? 'block' : 'none';
                    }
                }
                
                // Set animation values
                const fields = ['anim_x', 'anim_y', 'anim_z', 'anim_rot_x', 'anim_rot_y', 'anim_rot_z', 'anim_scale', 'anim_opacity', 'anim_duration'];
                fields.forEach(field => {
                    const input = document.getElementById(`edit-layer-${layerNum}-${field.replace(/_/g, '-')}`);
                    if (input && layerData[field] !== undefined) {
                        input.value = layerData[field];
                    }
                });
                
                // Show current filename if exists
                const currentFileInfo = document.getElementById(`edit-layer-${layerNum}-current`);
                if (currentFileInfo && layerData.filename) {
                    currentFileInfo.textContent = `Huidig: ${layerData.filename}`;
                    currentFileInfo.style.color = '#27ae60';
                } else if (currentFileInfo) {
                    currentFileInfo.textContent = 'Geen afbeelding';
                    currentFileInfo.style.color = '#999';
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Clear file inputs
        document.getElementById('edit-jpeg').value = '';
        document.getElementById('edit-pdf-medium').value = '';
        document.getElementById('edit-pdf-large').value = '';
        const arMarkerInput = document.getElementById('edit-ar-marker-file');
        if (arMarkerInput) arMarkerInput.value = '';
        
        // Clear layer file inputs (only active layers)
        for (const layerNum of activeLayers) {
            const fileInput = document.getElementById(`edit-layer-${layerNum}-image`);
            if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';
        }
        
        // Clear messages
        document.getElementById('edit-success').textContent = '';
        document.getElementById('edit-error').textContent = '';
        
        // Show modal
        document.getElementById('edit-modal').style.display = 'block';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error opening edit modal:', error);

        const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');

        // Scene has autoStart: false, so we control when it starts
        if (window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0) {
            const poster = window.allPosters[0];
            if (poster.ar_marker) {
                // Add cache-busting parameter to prevent browser caching corrupt files
                const cacheBuster = Date.now();
                const markerPath = poster.ar_marker + '.mind?v=' + cacheBuster;
                console.log('🎯 Setting AR marker to:', markerPath);
                
                // Validate .mind file before setting it
                try {
                    const testFetch = await fetch(markerPath);
                    if (!testFetch.ok) {
                        console.error('❌ Failed to fetch .mind file:', testFetch.status);
                        throw new Error('Mind file not found');
                    }
                    const buffer = await testFetch.arrayBuffer();
                    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
                    console.log('📦 .mind file size:', buffer.byteLength, 'bytes');
                    console.log('📦 .mind file header (first 20 bytes):', Array.from(bytes.slice(0, 20)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' '));
                    
                    // Check for valid MindAR v2 header (MessagePack format)
                    // Should start with 82 a1 76 02 (map with 2 elements, string "v", value 2)
                    if (bytes[0] !== 0x82 || bytes[1] !== 0xa1 || bytes[2] !== 0x76 || bytes[3] !== 0x02) {
                        console.error('❌ Invalid .mind file header! Expected MindAR v2 format.');
                        console.error('   Got:', bytes[0].toString(16), bytes[1].toString(16), bytes[2].toString(16), bytes[3].toString(16));
                        console.error('   Expected: 82 a1 76 02');
                        alert('Het .mind bestand is ongeldig. Upload een nieuw bestand via de admin pagina.');
                        return;
                    }
                    console.log('✅ .mind file header valid (MindAR v2 format)');
                } catch (fetchError) {
                    console.error('❌ Error validating .mind file:', fetchError);
                }
                
                // Set the full mindar-image attribute with the marker path
                scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${markerPath}; autoStart: false; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no; maxTrack: 1; filterMinCF: 0.003; filterBeta: 0.025; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 5;`);
            }
        }

                        throw new Error('Mind file not found');

                        console.error('❌ Invalid .mind file header! Expected MindAR v2 format.');
                        alert('Het .mind bestand is ongeldig. Upload een nieuw bestand via de admin pagina.');

                    console.log('✅ .mind file header valid (MindAR v2 format)');

            console.warn('⚠️ Scene taking too long to load, checking status...');
            if (!scene.hasLoaded) {
                console.error('❌ Scene failed to load within timeout');
                alert('AR initialization timeout. Please check camera permissions and try again.');
            }
        }, 10000);

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    
    // Check camera permissions first
    requestCameraPermission().then(() => {
        // NOW set the mindar-image attribute with the marker path (after scene loaded, before starting)
        if (window.arMarkerPath) {
            console.log('🎯 Setting mindar-image attribute with marker:', window.arMarkerPath);
            scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; autoStart: false; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no; maxTrack: 1; filterMinCF: 0.003; filterBeta: 0.025; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 5;`);
        } else {
            console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
            return;
        }
        
        // Wait a bit for MindAR to initialize the component
        setTimeout(() => {
            // Add MindAR targets after permission granted
            addMindARTargets(scene);
            
            // Start MindAR manually (since autoStart is false)
            console.log('🚀 Starting MindAR manually...');
            const arSystem = scene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
            if (arSystem) {
                arSystem.start();
                console.log('✅ MindAR started');
            } else {
                console.error('❌ MindAR system not found!');
            }
        }, 100);
        
    // Listen for MindAR ready event
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Get MindAR's camera stream and put it in our background video
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            const backgroundVideo = document.getElementById('camera-feed');
            let mindARVideo = null;
            
            // Find the video with active stream (MindAR's video)
            allVideos.forEach(v => {
                if (v.srcObject && v.videoWidth > 0) {
                    mindARVideo = v;
                }
            });
            
            console.log('📹 Found videos:', allVideos.length);
            console.log('📹 MindAR video:', mindARVideo ? 'YES' : 'NO');
            console.log('📹 Background video:', backgroundVideo ? 'YES' : 'NO');
            
            if (mindARVideo && backgroundVideo) {
                console.log('📹 Copying camera stream to background video');
                backgroundVideo.srcObject = mindARVideo.srcObject;
```

function initializeARScene() {

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    
    // Check camera permissions first
    requestCameraPermission().then(() => {
        // NOW set the mindar-image attribute with the marker path (after scene loaded, before starting)
        if (window.arMarkerPath) {
            console.log('🎯 Setting mindar-image attribute with marker:', window.arMarkerPath);
            scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; autoStart: false; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no; maxTrack: 1; filterMinCF: 0.003; filterBeta: 0.025; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 5;`);
        } else {
            console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
            return;
        }
        
        // Wait a bit for MindAR to initialize the component
        setTimeout(() => {
            // Add MindAR targets after permission granted
            addMindARTargets(scene);
            
            // Start MindAR manually (since autoStart is false)
            console.log('🚀 Starting MindAR manually...');
            const arSystem = scene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
            if (arSystem) {
                arSystem.start();
                console.log('✅ MindAR started');
            } else {
                console.error('❌ MindAR system not found!');
            }
        }, 100);
        
    // Listen for MindAR ready event
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to MindAR's video element
        // This ensures the filter is on the same video that MindAR uses for tracking
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log('📹 Found videos:', allVideos.length);
            
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                if (v.srcObject) {
                    console.log(`📹 Video ${i}: applying grayscale filter`);
                    // Apply B&W filter directly to MindAR's video
                    v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
                    v.style.position = 'absolute';
                    v.style.top = '0';
                    v.style.left = '0';
                    v.style.width = '100%';
                    v.style.height = '100%';
                    v.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                }
            });
        }, 500);

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    
    // Set the mindar-image attribute with the marker path
    if (window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.log('🎯 Setting mindar-image attribute with marker:', window.arMarkerPath);
        // Let MindAR handle its own camera - don't interfere!
        scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: yes; uiError: yes; uiScanning: yes; maxTrack: 1; filterMinCF: 0.001; filterBeta: 0.001; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 5;`);
    } else {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // Add the image target entity
    addMindARTargets(scene);
    
    // Listen for MindAR ready event
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to MindAR's video element
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log('📹 Found videos:', allVideos.length);
            
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                console.log(`📹 Video ${i}: applying grayscale filter`);
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
            });
        }, 500);
        
        // Force canvas to take full size and be visible
        setTimeout(() => {
            const canvas = document.querySelector('a-scene canvas');
            if (canvas) {
                const container = document.getElementById('ar-camera-container');
                const width = container ? container.clientWidth : window.innerWidth;
                const height = container ? container.clientHeight : window.innerHeight * 0.8;
                
                console.log(`🎨 Setting canvas size to ${width}x${height}`);
                canvas.width = width;
                canvas.height = height;
                canvas.style.width = width + 'px';
                canvas.style.height = height + 'px';
                // Make sure canvas is visible and on top - FORCE IT!
                canvas.style.opacity = '1';
                canvas.style.visibility = 'visible';
                canvas.style.zIndex = '10';
                canvas.style.position = 'absolute';
                canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                console.log('🎨 Canvas z-index forced to:', canvas.style.zIndex);
            }
            
            // Make video visible behind canvas
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log(`📹 Found ${allVideos.length} video elements, making them visible`);
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                if (v.videoWidth > 0 && v.videoHeight > 0) {
                    console.log(`📹 Video ${i}: ${v.videoWidth}x${v.videoHeight}, making visible`);
                    v.style.position = 'absolute';
                    v.style.top = '0';
                    v.style.left = '0';
                    v.style.width = '100%';
                    v.style.height = '100%';
                    v.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                    v.style.zIndex = '-1';
                    v.style.display = 'block';
                    v.style.visibility = 'visible';
                    // Apply B&W filter to all video elements (camera feed)
                    v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
                }
            });
        }, 100);
        
        // Safari-specific WebGL fix: Force context preservation
        setTimeout(() => {
            const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
            if (scene && scene.renderer) {
                const gl = scene.renderer.getContext();
                if (gl) {
                    console.log('🎮 WebGL context info:', {
                        vendor: gl.getParameter(gl.VENDOR),
                        renderer: gl.getParameter(gl.RENDERER),
                        version: gl.getParameter(gl.VERSION)
                    });
                    
                    // Force context to stay active (Safari fix)
                    try {
                        const loseContextExt = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context');
                        if (loseContextExt) {
                            console.log('✅ WebGL context preservation enabled');
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.warn('⚠️ Could not enable context preservation:', e);
                    }
                }
            }
        }, 200);
        
        // Debug: Check camera elements
        setTimeout(() => {
            const video = document.querySelector('a-scene video');
            const canvas = document.querySelector('a-scene canvas');
            console.log('🎥 Video element:', video ? `Found (${video.videoWidth}x${video.videoHeight})` : 'NOT FOUND');
            console.log('🖼️ Canvas element:', canvas ? `Found (${canvas.width}x${canvas.height})` : 'NOT FOUND');
            
            if (canvas) {
                console.log('🎨 Canvas style:', {
                    display: canvas.style.display || getComputedStyle(canvas).display,
                    visibility: canvas.style.visibility || getComputedStyle(canvas).visibility,
                    opacity: canvas.style.opacity || getComputedStyle(canvas).opacity,
                    zIndex: canvas.style.zIndex || getComputedStyle(canvas).zIndex,
                    position: canvas.style.position || getComputedStyle(canvas).position
                });
            }
            
            // Check all video elements

        setupModal();
