// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    
    // Set the mindar-image attribute with the marker path
    if (window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.log('🎯 Setting mindar-image attribute with marker:', window.arMarkerPath);
        scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: yes; uiError: yes; uiScanning: yes; maxTrack: 1; filterMinCF: 0.001; filterBeta: 0.001; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 5;`);
    } else {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // Get the existing target entity from HTML and set mindar-image-target attribute
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    if (target) {
        target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
        console.log('✅ Set mindar-image-target on existing entity');
        
        // Add layers to the target
        addLayersToTarget(target);
    } else {
        console.error('❌ Target entity #ar-target-0 not found in HTML!');
    }
    
    // Listen for MindAR ready event
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to MindAR's video element
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log('📹 Found videos:', allVideos.length);
            
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                console.log(`📹 Video ${i}: applying grayscale filter`);
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
            });
        }, 500);
    });
    
    scene.addEventListener('arError', (event) => {
        console.error('❌ MindAR error:', event);
        alert('AR Error: ' + (event.error || 'Unknown error. Check camera permissions.'));
    });
    
    // Setup swipe bar controls
    setupSwipeBarControls();
    
    // Setup gallery overlay
    setupGalleryOverlay();
    
    // Force gallery overlay styles via JavaScript
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        #gallery-overlay { background: #af1d1f !important; }
        .overlay-header { background: #af1d1f !important; padding: 14px 20px !important; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important; }
        #gallery-overlay-grid { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 2rem !important; padding: 1.5rem !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card { display: block !important; background: transparent !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card:active { opacity: 0.7 !important; transform: scale(0.98) !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card img { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block !important; border: none !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card h3 { padding: 10px 0 0 0 !important; font-size: 0.95rem !important; font-weight: 400 !important; color: #000 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
        .overlay-title { font-size: 1rem !important; font-weight: 500 !important; color: #000 !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; }
        .close-overlay-btn { background: transparent !important; color: #000 !important; font-size: 1.8rem !important; width: 40px !important; height: 40px !important; }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
    
    console.log('✅ AR.js scene initialized');
}

// Add layers to an existing target entity
function addLayersToTarget(target) {
    const poster = window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0 ? window.allPosters[0] : null;
    
    if (!poster) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No poster data available for layers');
        return;
    }
    
    console.log('📋 Adding layers for poster:', poster.title);
    
    let layerCount = 0;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        console.log('🎨 Creating layers from poster data:', poster.layers);
        
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (!layerData || !layerData.filename) {
                console.log(`⏭️ Layer ${i}: skipped (no file)`);
                continue;
            }
            
            layerCount++;
            console.log(`🖼️ Layer ${i}:`, layerData);
            
            const zPos = parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0.001;
            
            // Create layer using a-image
            const layer = document.createElement('a-image');
            layer.setAttribute('id', `ar-layer-${i}`);
            layer.setAttribute('position', `0 0 ${zPos}`);
            layer.setAttribute('width', '1');
            layer.setAttribute('height', '1');
            
            const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
            console.log(`📁 Layer ${i} image path:`, imagePath);
            
            layer.setAttribute('src', imagePath);
            layer.setAttribute('transparent', 'true');
            layer.setAttribute('alpha-test', '0.5');
            
            target.appendChild(layer);
        }
    }
    
    console.log(`✅ Added ${layerCount} layers to target`);
}
```

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    
    // Update the mindar-image attribute with the marker path
    // The base mindar-image attribute is already in HTML, we just add the imageTargetSrc
    if (window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.log('🎯 Setting imageTargetSrc:', window.arMarkerPath);
        const existingAttr = scene.getAttribute('mindar-image');
        scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `${existingAttr}; imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath};`);
    } else {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // Add layers to the existing target entity
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    if (target) {
        console.log('✅ Found target entity, adding layers');
        addLayersToTarget(target);
    } else {
        console.error('❌ Target entity #ar-target-0 not found in HTML!');
    }
```

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    
    // Set the mindar-image attribute with the marker path
    if (window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.log('🎯 Setting mindar-image attribute with marker:', window.arMarkerPath);
        scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: yes; uiError: yes; uiScanning: yes; maxTrack: 1; filterMinCF: 0.001; filterBeta: 0.001; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 5;`);
    } else {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // Get the existing target entity from HTML and set mindar-image-target attribute
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    if (target) {
        target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
        console.log('✅ Set mindar-image-target on existing entity');
        
        // Add layers to the target
        addLayersToTarget(target);
    } else {
        console.error('❌ Target entity #ar-target-0 not found in HTML!');
    }

        // Debug and fix video visibility
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log('📹 Found videos:', allVideos.length);
            
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                console.log(`📹 Video ${i}:`, {
                    src: v.src,
                    srcObject: v.srcObject ? 'MediaStream' : 'none',
                    width: v.videoWidth,
                    height: v.videoHeight,
                    readyState: v.readyState,
                    paused: v.paused
                });
                
                // CRITICAL: Move video OUTSIDE a-scene to make it visible
                // Remove it from wherever it is and add to container
                const container = document.getElementById('ar-scene-container');
                if (v.parentElement) {
                    v.parentElement.removeChild(v);
                }
                container.insertBefore(v, container.firstChild);
                
                // Style the video to be behind canvas
                v.style.position = 'absolute';
                v.style.top = '0';
                v.style.left = '0';
                v.style.width = '100%';
                v.style.height = '100%';
                v.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                v.style.zIndex = '1';
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
                v.style.display = 'block';
                v.style.visibility = 'visible';
                v.style.opacity = '1';
                
                console.log(`✅ Video ${i} repositioned and styled`);
            });
            
            // Check canvas elements and ensure they're transparent

            console.log('🎨 Found canvases:', allCanvases.length);
            allCanvases.forEach((c, i) => {
                c.style.background = 'transparent';
                c.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                console.log(`🎨 Canvas ${i} made transparent`);
            });
        }, 500);

    // Add layers after a short delay to ensure target is ready
    setTimeout(() => {
        const targetEntity = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
        if (targetEntity) {
            console.log('✅ Found target entity, setting up layer system');
            
            // Store poster data for when target is found
            window.currentPoster = window.allPosters[0];
            window.layersAdded = false;
            
            // Add tracking event listeners
            targetEntity.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
                console.log('🎯 TARGET FOUND! Marker detected!');
                
                // Add layers only once when first found
                if (!window.layersAdded && window.currentPoster) {
                    console.log('🎨 Adding layers now...');
                    addLayersToTarget(targetEntity, window.currentPoster);
                    window.layersAdded = true;
                }
                
                // Make target visible
                targetEntity.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
            });
            
            targetEntity.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
                console.log('🚫 TARGET LOST! Marker no longer visible');
                // Keep layers but hide target
                targetEntity.setAttribute('visible', 'false');
            });
        } else {
            console.error('❌ Target entity not found!');
        }
    }, 500);
```

            console.log(`📁 Layer ${i} image path:`, imagePath);
            
            // Set material with texture
            layer.setAttribute('material', `src: ${imagePath}; transparent: true; opacity: 1; side: double; shader: flat;`);
            
            console.log(`✨ Layer ${i} created at z=${actualZ}, src=${imagePath}`);
            target.appendChild(layer);
        }
```

    scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', mindarConfig);

    // Create a-assets container for preloading images
    const assets = document.createElement('a-assets');
    scene.appendChild(assets);
    
    // Create camera

    camera.setAttribute('position', '0 0 0');
    camera.setAttribute('look-controls', 'enabled: false');
    scene.appendChild(camera);
    
    // Create target entity
    const target = document.createElement('a-entity');
    target.id = 'ar-target-0';
    target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
    scene.appendChild(target);
    
    // Add scene to DOM - this will trigger initialization
    const container = document.getElementById('ar-scene-container');
    container.appendChild(scene);

- oldString:

```
            layerCount++;
            console.log(`🖼️ Layer ${i}:`, layerData);
            
            // Z position - move layers forward to be clearly visible
            const zPos = parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0;
            const actualZ = zPos === 0 ? 0.1 : zPos;  // Further from marker
            
            // Create layer using a-plane with explicit sizing
            const layer = document.createElement('a-plane');
            layer.setAttribute('id', `ar-layer-${i}`);
            layer.setAttribute('width', '0.8');  // Smaller than marker
            layer.setAttribute('height', '0.8');
            layer.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
            layer.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
            
            const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
            console.log(`📁 Layer ${i} image path:`, imagePath);
            
            // Set material with texture - use src attribute instead of material.src
            layer.setAttribute('src', imagePath);
            layer.setAttribute('material', 'transparent: true; opacity: 1; side: double; shader: flat;');
            
            target.appendChild(layer);
            
            // Force position AFTER appending to DOM (so A-Frame has initialized)
            setTimeout(() => {
                const addedLayer = document.getElementById(`ar-layer-${i}`);
                if (addedLayer && addedLayer.object3D) {
                    addedLayer.object3D.position.set(0, 0, actualZ);
                    console.log(`✅ Layer ${i} position forced to (0, 0, ${actualZ})`);
                }
            }, 100);
            
            console.log(`✨ Layer ${i} created: size="0.8x0.8" src="${imagePath}"`);
        }

                }
                container.insertBefore(v, container.firstChild);

<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">

    <title>AR Poster Test</title>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.5/dist/mindar-image-aframe.prod.js"></script>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        #info {
            position: fixed;
            top: 10px;
            left: 10px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
            color: white;
            padding: 10px;
            font-family: monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            z-index: 9999;
            max-width: 300px;
        }
        #poster-select {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            left: 10px;
            right: 10px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            z-index: 9999;
            max-height: 40vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        #poster-select h3 {
            color: white;
            margin: 0 0 10px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }
        .poster-btn {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            margin: 5px 0;
            background: #af1d1f;
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-size: 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .poster-btn:active {
            background: #8a1719;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="info">
        Laden...<br>
        Kies eerst een poster hieronder.
    </div>
    
    <div id="poster-select">
        <h3>Kies een poster om te scannen:</h3>
        <div id="poster-buttons">
            Laden...
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const API_URL = window.location.origin + '/api.php';
        const info = document.getElementById('info');
        let currentScene = null;
        
        // Load posters from API
        async function loadPosters() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters`);
                const posters = await response.json();
                
                const container = document.getElementById('poster-buttons');
                container.innerHTML = '';
                
                posters.forEach((poster, index) => {
                    if (poster.ar_marker) {
                        const btn = document.createElement('button');
                        btn.className = 'poster-btn';
                        btn.textContent = poster.title || `Poster ${index + 1}`;
                        btn.onclick = () => startAR(poster);
                        container.appendChild(btn);
                    }
                });
                
                if (container.children.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = '<p style="color: white;">Geen posters met AR markers gevonden.</p>';
                }
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading posters:', error);
                document.getElementById('poster-buttons').innerHTML = 
                    '<p style="color: red;">Fout bij laden van posters: ' + error.message + '</p>';
            }
        }
        
        function startAR(poster) {
            // Hide poster selector
            document.getElementById('poster-select').style.display = 'none';
            
            // Remove existing scene if any
            if (currentScene) {
                currentScene.remove();
            }
            
            const markerPath = poster.ar_marker + '.mind';
            info.innerHTML = `Loading AR for: ${poster.title}<br>Marker: ${markerPath}`;
            
            // Create scene HTML - exact same structure as working ar-test.html
            const sceneHTML = `
                <a-scene
                    mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${markerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0001; filterBeta: 10;"
                    color-space="sRGB"
                    renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
                    vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                    device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
                    
                    <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
                    
                    <a-entity mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                        <!-- Red test box - should be visible when marker found -->
                        <a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>
                        
                        <!-- AR Layer image if available -->
                        ${poster.ar_layer ? `<a-plane 
                            src="${poster.ar_layer}" 
                            position="0 0 0.05" 
                            height="0.5" 
                            width="0.35" 
                            rotation="0 0 0"
                            material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5;"></a-plane>` : ''}
                    </a-entity>
                </a-scene>
            `;
            
            // Add to body
            document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
            currentScene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
            
            // Add event listeners
            currentScene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
                info.innerHTML = `✅ AR Ready!<br>Scan de poster: ${poster.title}`;
                console.log('MindAR ready for:', poster.title);
            });
            
            currentScene.addEventListener('arError', (event) => {
                info.innerHTML = `❌ AR Error: ${event.error}`;
                console.error('MindAR error:', event);
            });
            
            const target = currentScene.querySelector('[mindar-image-target]');
            target.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
                info.innerHTML = `🎯 GEVONDEN!<br>${poster.title}`;
                console.log('Target found:', poster.title);
            });
            
            target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
                info.innerHTML = `👁️ Zoeken naar...<br>${poster.title}`;
                console.log('Target lost');
            });
        }
        
        // Initialize
        loadPosters();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Using HTML string injection like working test
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    const poster = window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0 ? window.allPosters[0] : null;
    console.log('🎯 Creating scene with imageTargetSrc:', window.arMarkerPath);
    
    // Build AR layer HTML if available
    let layerHTML = '';
    if (poster && poster.ar_layer) {
        layerHTML = `<a-plane 
            src="${poster.ar_layer}" 
            position="0 0 0.05" 
            height="0.5" 
            width="0.35" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5;"></a-plane>`;
        console.log('📋 AR layer will be added:', poster.ar_layer);
    }
    
    // Create scene using HTML string - EXACTLY like the working ar-poster-test.html
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 1; filterBeta: 10000; warmupTolerance: 1; missTolerance: 1;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                <a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>
                ${layerHTML}
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body using insertAdjacentHTML (same as working test)
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added to body (fullscreen mode)');
    
    // Get references to scene and target
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    
    // Add event listeners
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to video
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
            });
        }, 500);
    });
    
    scene.addEventListener('arError', (event) => {
        console.error('❌ MindAR error:', event);
        alert('AR Error: ' + (event.error || 'Unknown error. Check camera permissions.'));
    });
    
    target.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
        console.log('🎯 TARGET FOUND! Marker detected!');
        if (poster) {
            showDetectedPosterState(poster);
        }
    });
    
    target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
        console.log('🚫 TARGET LOST! Marker no longer visible');
        hideDetectedPosterState();
    });
    
    // Setup swipe bar controls
    setupSwipeBarControls();
    
    // Setup gallery overlay
    setupGalleryOverlay();
    
    // Force gallery overlay styles via JavaScript
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        #gallery-overlay { background: #af1d1f !important; }
        .overlay-header { background: #af1d1f !important; padding: 14px 20px !important; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important; }
        #gallery-overlay-grid { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 2rem !important; padding: 1.5rem !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card { display: block !important; background: transparent !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card:active { opacity: 0.7 !important; transform: scale(0.98) !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card img { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block !important; border: none !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card h3 { padding: 10px 0 0 0 !important; font-size: 0.95rem !important; font-weight: 400 !important; color: #000 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
        .overlay-title { font-size: 1rem !important; font-weight: 500 !important; color: #000 !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; }
        .close-overlay-btn { background: transparent !important; color: #000 !important; font-size: 1.8rem !important; width: 40px !important; height: 40px !important; }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
    
    console.log('✅ AR scene initialized');
}

// Show detected poster state in footer
function showDetectedPosterState(poster) {
    const state1 = document.getElementById('swipe-state-1');
    const state2 = document.getElementById('swipe-state-2');
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('detected-poster-title');
    
    if (state1) state1.classList.remove('active');
    if (state2) state2.classList.add('active');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = poster.title || 'Poster';
}

// Hide detected poster state
function hideDetectedPosterState() {
    const state1 = document.getElementById('swipe-state-1');
    const state2 = document.getElementById('swipe-state-2');
    
    if (state1) state1.classList.add('active');
    if (state2) state2.classList.remove('active');
}

// Legacy function - no longer needed but keep for compatibility
function addLayersToTarget(target) {
    console.log('📋 addLayersToTarget called (layers now added in scene HTML)');
}

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    console.log('🎯 Creating scene with imageTargetSrc:', window.arMarkerPath);
    
    // Create scene element with all attributes BEFORE adding to DOM
    // Following the official MindAR example structure - NO embedded attribute for fullscreen!
    const scene = document.createElement('a-scene');
    scene.id = 'ar-scene';
    // REMOVED: scene.setAttribute('embedded', ''); - embedded prevents fullscreen camera
    scene.setAttribute('vr-mode-ui', 'enabled: false');
    scene.setAttribute('device-orientation-permission-ui', 'enabled: false');
    scene.setAttribute('color-space', 'sRGB');
    scene.setAttribute('renderer', 'colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;');
    
    // Set mindar-image with the marker path - RELAXED parameters for easier detection
    const mindarConfig = `imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0001; filterBeta: 10; warmupTolerance: 50; missTolerance: 50; maxTrack: 1;`;
    scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', mindarConfig);
    console.log('📝 Set mindar-image attribute');
    
    // Create camera
    const camera = document.createElement('a-camera');
    camera.setAttribute('position', '0 0 0');
    camera.setAttribute('look-controls', 'enabled: false');
    scene.appendChild(camera);
    
    // Create target entity
    const target = document.createElement('a-entity');
    target.id = 'ar-target-0';
    target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
    scene.appendChild(target);
    
    // Add scene directly to body for fullscreen AR (like the working ar-test.html)
    // Header and footer will overlay on top
    document.body.appendChild(scene);
    console.log('✅ Scene added to body (fullscreen mode)');
    
    // Add layers after a short delay to ensure target is ready
    setTimeout(() => {
        const targetEntity = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
        if (targetEntity) {
            console.log('✅ Found target entity, setting up layer system');
            
            // Store poster data for when target is found
            window.currentPoster = window.allPosters[0];
            window.layersAdded = false;
            
            // Add tracking event listeners
            targetEntity.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
                console.log('🎯 TARGET FOUND! Marker detected!');
                
                // Add layers only once when first found
                if (!window.layersAdded && window.currentPoster) {
                    console.log('🎨 Adding layers now...');
                    addLayersToTarget(targetEntity, window.currentPoster);
                    
                    // Add a bright red test box to verify rendering works
                    const testBox = document.createElement('a-box');
                    testBox.setAttribute('id', 'test-box');
                    testBox.setAttribute('position', '0 0 0.2');
                    testBox.setAttribute('width', '0.3');
                    testBox.setAttribute('height', '0.3');
                    testBox.setAttribute('depth', '0.3');
                    testBox.setAttribute('color', '#FF0000');
                    targetEntity.appendChild(testBox);
                    console.log('🔴 Added RED TEST BOX at position 0 0 0.2');
                    
                    // Debug: Log the entire target entity structure
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        console.log('🔍 Target entity HTML:', targetEntity.outerHTML);
                        console.log('🔍 Target entity object3D:', targetEntity.object3D);
                        console.log('🔍 Target entity visible:', targetEntity.getAttribute('visible'));
                        console.log('🔍 Target entity position:', targetEntity.object3D.position);
                        console.log('🔍 Target entity children count:', targetEntity.children.length);
                        
                        // Check if children are actually rendered
                        for (let i = 0; i < targetEntity.children.length; i++) {
                            const child = targetEntity.children[i];
                            console.log(`🔍 Child ${i}:`, {
                                tagName: child.tagName,
                                id: child.id,
                                visible: child.getAttribute('visible'),
                                position: child.getAttribute('position'),
                                hasObject3D: !!child.object3D
                            });
                        }
                    }, 1000);
                    
                    window.layersAdded = true;
                }
                
                // Make target visible
                targetEntity.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
                console.log('👁️ Target set to visible');
            });
            
            targetEntity.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
                console.log('🚫 TARGET LOST! Marker no longer visible');
                // Keep layers but hide target
                targetEntity.setAttribute('visible', 'false');
            });
        } else {
            console.error('❌ Target entity not found!');
        }
    }, 500);
    
    // Listen for MindAR ready event
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Just apply grayscale filter to video, don't move it
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            console.log('📹 Found videos:', allVideos.length);
            
            allVideos.forEach((v, i) => {
                console.log(`📹 Video ${i}:`, {
                    srcObject: v.srcObject ? 'MediaStream' : 'none',
                    width: v.videoWidth,
                    height: v.videoHeight
                });
                
                // Only apply filter, don't move the video!
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(1.3) brightness(0.95)';
                console.log(`✅ Video ${i} filter applied`);
            });
        }, 500);
    });
    
    scene.addEventListener('arError', (event) => {
        console.error('❌ MindAR error:', event);
        alert('AR Error: ' + (event.error || 'Unknown error. Check camera permissions.'));
    });
    
    // Setup swipe bar controls
    setupSwipeBarControls();
    
    // Setup gallery overlay
    setupGalleryOverlay();
    
    // Force gallery overlay styles via JavaScript
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        #gallery-overlay { background: #af1d1f !important; }
        .overlay-header { background: #af1d1f !important; padding: 14px 20px !important; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important; }
        #gallery-overlay-grid { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 2rem !important; padding: 1.5rem !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card { display: block !important; background: transparent !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card:active { opacity: 0.7 !important; transform: scale(0.98) !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card img { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block !important; border: none !important; }

    // Add custom smoothing component for stable AR
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 1; filterBeta: 10000; warmupTolerance: 1; missTolerance: 1;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                <!-- Smoothed container for AR content -->
                <a-entity id="ar-content-smoothed">
                    <a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>
                    ${layerHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body using insertAdjacentHTML (same as working test)
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added to body (fullscreen mode)');

    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    
    // Add position smoothing after scene is ready
    scene.addEventListener('loaded', () => {
        const smoothedContent = document.getElementById('ar-content-smoothed');
        if (smoothedContent && smoothedContent.object3D) {
            // Store previous position for smoothing
            let lastPos = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
            let lastRot = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
            const smoothFactor = 0.15; // Lower = smoother but slower (0.1-0.3)
            
            // Smooth position on each frame
            scene.addEventListener('tick', () => {
                const parent = target.object3D;

    // Create scene using HTML string - EXACTLY like the working ar-poster-test.html
    // Add custom smoothing component for stable AR
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 1; filterBeta: 10000; warmupTolerance: 1; missTolerance: 1;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                <!-- Smoothed container for AR content -->
                <a-entity id="ar-content-smoothed">
                    <a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>
                    ${layerHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body using insertAdjacentHTML (same as working test)
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added to body (fullscreen mode)');
    
    // Get references to scene and target
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    
    // Add position smoothing after scene is ready
    scene.addEventListener('loaded', () => {
        const smoothedContent = document.getElementById('ar-content-smoothed');
        if (smoothedContent && smoothedContent.object3D) {
            // Store previous position for smoothing
            let lastPos = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
            let lastRot = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
            const smoothFactor = 0.15; // Lower = smoother but slower (0.1-0.3)
            
            // Smooth position on each frame
            scene.addEventListener('tick', () => {
                const parent = target.object3D;
                if (parent && parent.visible) {
                    // Lerp position
                    lastPos.x += (parent.position.x - lastPos.x) * smoothFactor;
                    lastPos.y += (parent.position.y - lastPos.y) * smoothFactor;
                    lastPos.z += (parent.position.z - lastPos.z) * smoothFactor;
                    
                    // Lerp rotation
                    lastRot.x += (parent.rotation.x - lastRot.x) * smoothFactor;
                    lastRot.y += (parent.rotation.y - lastRot.y) * smoothFactor;
                    lastRot.z += (parent.rotation.z - lastRot.z) * smoothFactor;
                }
            });
            console.log('✅ Position smoothing enabled');
        }
    });

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Using HTML string injection like working test
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    const poster = window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0 ? window.allPosters[0] : null;
    console.log('🎯 Creating scene with imageTargetSrc:', window.arMarkerPath);
    
    // Build AR layer HTML if available
    let layerHTML = '';
    if (poster && poster.ar_layer) {
        layerHTML = `<a-plane 
            src="${poster.ar_layer}" 
            position="0 0 0.05" 
            height="0.5" 
            width="0.35" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.5;"></a-plane>`;
        console.log('📋 AR layer will be added:', poster.ar_layer);
    }
    
    // EXTREME stability: filterMinCF as low as possible
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.00001; filterBeta: 10;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                <!-- Smoothed content wrapper -->
                <a-entity id="ar-smoothed-content">
                    <a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>
                    ${layerHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body using insertAdjacentHTML (same as working test)
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added to body (fullscreen mode)');
    
    // Get references to scene and target
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    
    // Custom smoothing system - runs after scene loads
    scene.addEventListener('loaded', () => {
        setupCustomSmoothing();
    });
```

// Custom smoothing for AR content - reduces jitter significantly
function setupCustomSmoothing(target) {
    const smoothedContent = document.getElementById('ar-smoothed-content');
    if (!smoothedContent || !smoothedContent.object3D) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Smoothed content not found');
        return;
    }
    
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    const THREE = AFRAME.THREE;
    
    // Smoothing state
    let lastPosition = new THREE.Vector3();
    let lastQuaternion = new THREE.Quaternion();
    let lastScale = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1);
    let initialized = false;
    
    // Smoothing factor (0.05 = very smooth but laggy, 0.3 = less smooth but responsive)
    const positionSmooth = 0.08;
    const rotationSmooth = 0.08;
    const scaleSmooth = 0.1;
    
    // Tick handler for smoothing
    const tickHandler = () => {
        if (!target.object3D || !target.object3D.visible) return;
        
        const targetObj = target.object3D;
        const contentObj = smoothedContent.object3D;
        
        // Get world transform of target
        const worldPos = new THREE.Vector3();
        const worldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
        const worldScale = new THREE.Vector3();
        targetObj.matrixWorld.decompose(worldPos, worldQuat, worldScale);
        
        if (!initialized) {
            // First frame - snap to position
            lastPosition.copy(worldPos);
            lastQuaternion.copy(worldQuat);
            lastScale.copy(worldScale);
            initialized = true;
        } else {
            // Lerp towards target position
            lastPosition.lerp(worldPos, positionSmooth);
            lastQuaternion.slerp(worldQuat, rotationSmooth);
            lastScale.lerp(worldScale, scaleSmooth);
        }
        
        // Apply smoothed transform to content (relative to target)
        // Since content is child of target, we apply local offset
        // For now, just keep content at origin of target
        contentObj.position.set(0, 0, 0);
        contentObj.quaternion.identity();
        contentObj.scale.set(1, 1, 1);
    };
    
    // Register tick handler
    scene.addEventListener('tick', tickHandler);
    
    // Reset on target lost
    target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
        initialized = false;
    });
    
    console.log('✅ Custom smoothing enabled (factor: ' + positionSmooth + ')');

// Custom smoothing for AR content - reduces jitter significantly
// This moves content OUTSIDE the target and manually applies smoothed transforms
function setupCustomSmoothing(target) {
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    const THREE = AFRAME.THREE;
    
    // Create a new entity outside the target for smoothed content
    const smoothedWrapper = document.createElement('a-entity');
    smoothedWrapper.id = 'ar-smoothed-wrapper';
    scene.appendChild(smoothedWrapper);
    
    // Move all children from target's smoothed-content to the new wrapper
    const originalContent = document.getElementById('ar-smoothed-content');
    if (originalContent) {
        // Clone the children to the new wrapper
        Array.from(originalContent.children).forEach(child => {
            const clone = child.cloneNode(true);
            smoothedWrapper.appendChild(clone);
        });
        // Hide original content
        originalContent.setAttribute('visible', 'false');
    }
    
    // Smoothing state
    let lastMatrix = new THREE.Matrix4();
    let currentMatrix = new THREE.Matrix4();
    let initialized = false;
    let isVisible = false;
    
    // Smoothing factor (lower = smoother but more lag)
    const smoothFactor = 0.05; // Very smooth
    
    // Tick handler for smoothing
    const tickHandler = () => {
        const targetObj = target.object3D;
        const wrapperObj = smoothedWrapper.object3D;
        
        if (targetObj && targetObj.visible) {
            isVisible = true;
            
            // Get target's world matrix
            targetObj.updateMatrixWorld(true);
            currentMatrix.copy(targetObj.matrixWorld);
            
            if (!initialized) {
                // First frame - snap to position
                lastMatrix.copy(currentMatrix);
                initialized = true;
            } else {
                // Interpolate each element of the matrix
                for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                    lastMatrix.elements[i] += (currentMatrix.elements[i] - lastMatrix.elements[i]) * smoothFactor;
                }
            }
            
            // Apply smoothed matrix to wrapper
            wrapperObj.matrix.copy(lastMatrix);
            wrapperObj.matrix.decompose(wrapperObj.position, wrapperObj.quaternion, wrapperObj.scale);
            wrapperObj.visible = true;
            
        } else if (isVisible) {
            // Target lost - hide wrapper
            wrapperObj.visible = false;
            initialized = false;
            isVisible = false;
        }
    };
    
    // Register tick handler
    scene.addEventListener('tick', tickHandler);
    
    console.log('✅ Custom matrix smoothing enabled (factor: ' + smoothFactor + ')');
}

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Using HTML string injection like working test
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');

        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = parseFloat(layerData.z) || (i * 0.02);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                
                console.log(`📋 Layer ${i}: ${imagePath} at z=${zPos}`);
                
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-plane 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        height="1.4" 
                        width="1" 
                        rotation="0 0 0"
                        material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"></a-plane>`;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Fallback: if no layers, show test box
    if (!layersHTML) {

    <a-assets>
        <script id="inversion-shader" type="x-shader/x-fragment">
            precision mediump float;
            uniform sampler2D map;
            uniform vec3 tint;
            varying vec2 vUv;
            
            void main() {
                vec4 texColor = texture2D(map, vUv);
                // Invert the colors (white becomes black, etc)
                vec3 inverted = vec3(1.0 - texColor.r, 1.0 - texColor.g, 1.0 - texColor.b);
                gl_FragColor = vec4(inverted, texColor.a);
            }
        </script>
    </a-assets>

```
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Apply inversion effect to exclusion filter layers
        const exclusionLayers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-exclusion="true"]');
        exclusionLayers.forEach(layer => {
            const material = layer.components.material.material;
            if (material && material.map) {
                // Create a canvas for color inversion
                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                const img = new Image();
                img.onload = () => {
                    canvas.width = img.width;
                    canvas.height = img.height;
                    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
                    
                    // Invert the pixels
                    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                    const data = imageData.data;
                    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
                        data[i] = 255 - data[i];     // R
                        data[i + 1] = 255 - data[i + 1]; // G
                        data[i + 2] = 255 - data[i + 2]; // B
                        // Keep alpha unchanged
                    }
                    ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
                    
                    // Update the material with inverted texture
                    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
                    material.map = texture;
                    material.needsUpdate = true;
                    
                    console.log('✅ Inversion effect applied to layer:', layer.id);
                };
                img.src = layer.getAttribute('src');
            }
        });
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to video with maximum contrast
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 500);
    });
```

    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Apply inversion effect to exclusion filter layers
        const exclusionLayers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-exclusion="true"]');
        exclusionLayers.forEach(layer => {
            const material = layer.components.material.material;
            if (material && material.map) {
                // Create a canvas for selective color inversion
                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                const img = new Image();
                img.onload = () => {
                    canvas.width = img.width;
                    canvas.height = img.height;
                    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
                    
                    // Selective inversion: only invert non-red colors
                    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                    const data = imageData.data;
                    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
                        const r = data[i];
                        const g = data[i + 1];
                        const b = data[i + 2];
                        
                        // If it's not primarily red (r not significantly higher than g,b)
                        // then invert it
                        if (r < g + 50 && r < b + 50) {
                            // Invert this pixel
                            data[i] = 255 - r;
                            data[i + 1] = 255 - g;
                            data[i + 2] = 255 - b;
                        }
                        // Keep red pixels and alpha unchanged
                    }
                    ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
                    
                    // Update the material with inverted texture
                    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
                    material.map = texture;
                    material.needsUpdate = true;
                    
                    console.log('✅ Selective inversion effect applied to layer:', layer.id);
                };
                img.src = layer.getAttribute('src');
            }
        });
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to video with maximum contrast
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 500);
    });
```

    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready, camera active');
        
        // Process exclusion filter layers
        // Effect: black becomes red (layer color), white becomes black
        setTimeout(() => {
            const exclusionLayers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-exclusion="true"]');
            exclusionLayers.forEach(layer => {
                const imgSrc = layer.getAttribute('src');
                const img = new Image();
                img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
                img.onload = () => {
                    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                    canvas.width = img.width;
                    canvas.height = img.height;
                    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
                    
                    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                    const data = imageData.data;
                    
                    // Process each pixel
                    // Black (0,0,0) → Red (175, 29, 31) - the poster red color
                    // White (255,255,255) → Black (0,0,0)
                    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
                        const r = data[i];
                        const g = data[i + 1];
                        const b = data[i + 2];
                        const a = data[i + 3];
                        
                        // Calculate luminance (how bright the pixel is)
                        const luminance = (r + g + b) / 3;
                        
                        // Map luminance: 0 (black) → red, 255 (white) → black
                        // Inverse the luminance for the mapping
                        const factor = 1 - (luminance / 255);
                        
                        // Red color: #af1d1f = rgb(175, 29, 31)
                        data[i] = Math.round(175 * factor);     // R
                        data[i + 1] = Math.round(29 * factor);  // G
                        data[i + 2] = Math.round(31 * factor);  // B
                        // Keep alpha
                    }
                    
                    ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
                    
                    // Create new texture from canvas
                    const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
                    texture.needsUpdate = true;
                    
                    // Apply to material
                    const material = layer.getObject3D('mesh')?.material;
                    if (material) {
                        material.map = texture;
                        material.needsUpdate = true;
                        console.log('✅ Exclusion filter applied to:', layer.id);
                    }
                };
                img.src = imgSrc;
            });
        }, 1000);
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) {
            loader.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to video with maximum contrast
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 500);
    });
```

function addLayer(isEditForm = false) {
    const activeLayers = getActiveLayers();
    if (activeLayers.length >= LAYER_CONFIG.maxLayers) {
        alert(`Maximum van ${LAYER_CONFIG.maxLayers} lagen bereikt`);
        return;
    }
    
    // Find next available layer number
    let nextNum = 1;
    while (activeLayers.includes(nextNum)) {
        nextNum++;
    }
    
    activeLayers.push(nextNum);
    activeLayers.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    setActiveLayers(activeLayers);
    
    // Append only the new layer instead of re-rendering everything
    const containerEl = document.getElementById(isEditForm ? 'edit-layers-container' : 'layers-container');
    if (containerEl) {
        const layerHTML = generateLayerHTML(nextNum, isEditForm);
        
        // Find the correct position to insert (sorted order)
        const existingLayers = containerEl.querySelectorAll('.layer-section');
        let insertBefore = null;
        
        for (const layer of existingLayers) {
            const layerNumAttr = layer.querySelector('[data-layer]')?.dataset.layer;
            if (layerNumAttr && parseInt(layerNumAttr) > nextNum) {
                insertBefore = layer;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (insertBefore) {
            insertBefore.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', layerHTML);
        } else {
            containerEl.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', layerHTML);
        }
        
        // Setup animation toggle for the new layer
        setupLayerAnimationToggle(nextNum, isEditForm);
        
        // Setup remove button for new layer only
        const newLayerSection = containerEl.querySelector(`.layer-section:has([data-layer="${nextNum}"])`);
        if (newLayerSection) {
            const removeBtn = newLayerSection.querySelector('.remove-layer-btn');
            if (removeBtn) {
                removeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    const layerNum = parseInt(e.target.dataset.layer);
                    if (confirm(`Weet je zeker dat je laag ${layerNum} wilt verwijderen?`)) {
                        removeLayer(layerNum, isEditForm);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        
        // Update counter
        const counterEl = document.getElementById(isEditForm ? 'edit-layer-count-info' : 'layer-count-info');
        if (counterEl) counterEl.textContent = `Aantal lagen: ${activeLayers.length}`;
    }
}
```

function removeLayer(layerNum, isEditForm = false) {
    const activeLayers = getActiveLayers();
    
    // Minimum 1 layer required
    if (activeLayers.length <= 1) {
        alert('Er moet minimaal 1 laag zijn');
        return;
    }
    
    const index = activeLayers.indexOf(layerNum);
    if (index > -1) {
        activeLayers.splice(index, 1);
        setActiveLayers(activeLayers);
        
        // Remove only the specific layer section instead of re-rendering
        const containerEl = document.getElementById(isEditForm ? 'edit-layers-container' : 'layers-container');
        if (containerEl) {
            const layerSection = containerEl.querySelector(`.layer-section:has([data-layer="${layerNum}"])`);
            if (layerSection) {
                layerSection.remove();
            }
            
            // Update counter
            const counterEl = document.getElementById(isEditForm ? 'edit-layer-count-info' : 'layer-count-info');
            if (counterEl) counterEl.textContent = `Aantal lagen: ${activeLayers.length}`;
        }
    }
}

Kijk naar de belangrijke regels:

- **Regel 222**: Gebruikt alleen de eerste poster voor de AR lagen
- **Regel 644**: Zelfde probleem

De huidige implementatie ondersteunt slechts **één poster tegelijk** voor AR tracking. MindAR kan wel meerdere image targets in één `.mind` bestand ondersteunen, maar dan moeten alle poster markers in één gecombineerd `.mind` bestand zitten.

**Twee opties:**

2. **Alle posters combineren** - Alle poster markers moeten gecombineerd worden in één `all-posters.mind` bestand

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Multi-poster support
// Each poster gets its own target with targetIndex matching the order in all-posters.mind
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene with multi-poster support...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    console.log('🎯 Creating scene with imageTargetSrc:', window.arMarkerPath);
    console.log('📋 Total posters to track:', window.allPosters?.length || 0);
    
    // Build targets HTML for ALL posters
    // Each poster gets its own target entity with layers
    let targetsHTML = '';
    
    if (window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0) {
        window.allPosters.forEach((poster, index) => {
            console.log(`🎨 Building target ${index} for poster: ${poster.title}`);
            
            // Build layers HTML for this poster
            let layersHTML = '';
            
            // Add a black background layer first (layer 0) so we don't see through
            layersHTML += `
                <a-plane 
                    id="ar-layer-${index}-0"
                    position="0 0 0.05" 
                    height="1.4" 
                    width="1" 
                    rotation="0 0 0"
                    material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double;"></a-plane>`;
            
            if (poster.layers) {
                for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
                    const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
                    
                    if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                        const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                        const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                        
                        console.log(`📋 Poster ${index} Layer ${i}: ${imagePath} at z=${zPos}`);
                        
                        const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                        const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                        
                        layersHTML += `
                            <a-plane 
                                id="ar-layer-${index}-${i}"
                                src="${imagePath}" 
                                position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                                height="1.4" 
                                width="1" 
                                rotation="0 0 0"
                                ${materialAttr}
                                ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If no layers, show placeholder
            if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-' + index + '-1')) {
                console.log(`⚠️ No layers found for poster ${index}, showing placeholder`);
                layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
            }
            
            // Add target entity for this poster
            targetsHTML += `
            <a-entity id="ar-target-${index}" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: ${index}" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
                ${layersHTML}
            </a-entity>`;
        });
    } else {
        console.warn('⚠️ No posters available!');
        targetsHTML = `
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                <a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>
            </a-entity>`;
    }
    
    // Create scene with all targets
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 10;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            ${targetsHTML}
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added with', window.allPosters?.length || 0, 'targets');
    
    // Get reference to scene
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
```

        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {

                // Check for exclusion filter - will be processed after scene loads
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-plane 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        height="1.4" 
                        width="1" 
                        rotation="0 0 0"

            }
        }

    // Create scene using HTML string - WITHOUT smoothing wrapper for now
    const sceneHTML = `

            target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
                console.log(`🚫 TARGET ${index} LOST! Poster: ${poster.title}`);
                
                // Only reset UI if this was the currently tracked poster
                if (currentTrackedPoster && currentTrackedPoster.id === poster.id) {
                    // Show scan frame and camera again when target lost
                    const scanFrame = document.getElementById('scan-frame');
                    if (scanFrame) {
                        scanFrame.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    
                    // Show camera video again
                    const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
                    allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                        v.style.opacity = '1';
                    });
                    
                    hideDetectedPosterState();
                    currentTrackedPoster = null;
                }

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Dynamic single-poster loading
// Each poster has its own .mind file, we load one at a time
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene (dynamic mode)...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath || !window.arPosters) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path or posters available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // Get the current poster to display
    const currentPoster = window.arPosters[window.currentARPosterIndex || 0];
    console.log('🎯 Loading AR for poster:', currentPoster.title);
    console.log('📋 Using .mind file:', window.arMarkerPath);
    
    // Build layers HTML for the current poster only
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add a black background layer first (layer 0)
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 0.05" 
            height="1.4" 
            width="1" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (currentPoster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = currentPoster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                
                console.log(`📋 Layer ${i}: ${imagePath} at z=${zPos}`);
                
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-plane 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        height="1.4" 
                        width="1" 
                        rotation="0 0 0"
                        ${materialAttr}
                        ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // If no layers, show placeholder
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        console.log('⚠️ No layers found, showing placeholder');
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    // Create scene with single target
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 10;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${currentPoster.id}">
                ${layersHTML}
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added for poster:', currentPoster.title);
    
    // Get reference to scene and target
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Multi-poster support
// Each poster gets its own target with targetIndex matching the order in all-posters.mind
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene with multi-poster support...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path available!');
        return;
    }
    
    console.log('🎯 Creating scene with imageTargetSrc:', window.arMarkerPath);
    console.log('📋 Total posters to track:', window.allPosters?.length || 0);
    
    // Build targets HTML for ALL posters
    // Each poster gets its own target entity with layers
    let targetsHTML = '';
    
    if (window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0) {
        window.allPosters.forEach((poster, index) => {
            console.log(`🎨 Building target ${index} for poster: ${poster.title}`);
            
            // Build layers HTML for this poster
            let layersHTML = '';
            
            // Add a black background layer first (layer 0) so we don't see through
            layersHTML += `
                <a-plane 
                    id="ar-layer-${index}-0"
                    position="0 0 0.05" 
                    height="1.4" 
                    width="1" 
                    rotation="0 0 0"
                    material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double;"></a-plane>`;
            
            if (poster.layers) {
                for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
                    const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
                    
                    if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                        const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                        const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                        
                        console.log(`📋 Poster ${index} Layer ${i}: ${imagePath} at z=${zPos}`);
                        
                        const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                        const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                        
                        layersHTML += `
                            <a-plane 
                                id="ar-layer-${index}-${i}"
                                src="${imagePath}" 
                                position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                                height="1.4" 
                                width="1" 
                                rotation="0 0 0"
                                ${materialAttr}
                                ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If no layers, show placeholder
            if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-' + index + '-1')) {
                console.log(`⚠️ No layers found for poster ${index}, showing placeholder`);
                layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
            }
            
            // Add target entity for this poster
            targetsHTML += `
            <a-entity id="ar-target-${index}" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: ${index}" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
                ${layersHTML}
            </a-entity>`;
        });
    } else {
        console.warn('⚠️ No posters available!');
        targetsHTML = `
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                <a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>
            </a-entity>`;
    }
    
    // Create scene with all targets
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 10;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            ${targetsHTML}
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added with', window.allPosters?.length || 0, 'targets');
    
    // Get reference to scene
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');

                if (scanFrame) {

                // Hide camera video - show black background with AR content only
                const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
                allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                    v.style.opacity = '0';
                });
                
                // Update current tracked poster
                currentTrackedPoster = poster;
                showDetectedPosterState(poster);
            });
            
            target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
                console.log(`🚫 TARGET ${index} LOST! Poster: ${poster.title}`);
                
                // Only reset UI if this was the currently tracked poster
                if (currentTrackedPoster && currentTrackedPoster.id === poster.id) {
                    // Show scan frame and camera again when target lost
                    const scanFrame = document.getElementById('scan-frame');
                    if (scanFrame) {
                        scanFrame.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    
                    // Show camera video again
                    const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
                    allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                        v.style.opacity = '1';
                    });
                    
                    hideDetectedPosterState();
                    currentTrackedPoster = null;

// Switch to a different poster's AR marker
// This destroys the current scene and creates a new one with the selected poster
async function switchToPoster(posterId) {
    console.log('🔄 Switching to poster:', posterId);
    
    if (!window.arPosters) {
        console.error('❌ No AR posters available');
        return false;
    }
    
    // Find the poster by ID
    const posterIndex = window.arPosters.findIndex(p => p.id == posterId);
    if (posterIndex === -1) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Poster not found in AR posters:', posterId);
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    console.log('🎯 Switching to:', newPoster.title, '→', newPoster.mindPath);
    
    // Remove existing AR scene
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    if (existingScene) {
        // Stop MindAR first
        try {
            const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
            if (mindarSystem) {
                await mindarSystem.stop();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('⚠️ Could not stop MindAR:', e);
        }
        existingScene.remove();
        console.log('🗑️ Removed existing AR scene');
    }
    
    // Update global state
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
    
    // Re-initialize AR scene with new poster
    initializeARScene();
    
    // Collapse gallery/footer
    const swipeBar = document.getElementById('ar-footer-swipe-bar');
    if (swipeBar) {
        swipeBar.classList.remove('expanded');
    }
    
    console.log('✅ Switched to poster:', newPoster.title);
    return true;
}

// Request camera permission
