```
// Legacy function - no longer needed but keep for compatibility
function addLayersToTarget(target) {
    console.log('📋 addLayersToTarget called (layers now added in scene HTML)');
}

// ==================== ROTATING SCANNER SYSTEM ====================
// Automatically cycles through all .mind files to detect any poster in view
// Pauses when a poster is found, resumes when lost

// Start the rotating scanner
function startRotatingScanner() {
    if (scannerInterval) {
        console.log('⚠️ Scanner already running');
        return;
    }
    
    if (!window.arPosters || window.arPosters.length <= 1) {
        console.log('📌 Not enough posters for rotation');
        return;
    }
    
    console.log('🔄 Starting rotating scanner...');
    scannerPaused = false;
    
    scannerInterval = setInterval(async () => {
        if (scannerPaused) {
            console.log('⏸️ Scanner paused (poster detected)');
            return;
        }
        
        // Move to next poster
        const nextIndex = (window.currentARPosterIndex + 1) % window.arPosters.length;
        const nextPoster = window.arPosters[nextIndex];
        
        console.log(`🔄 Rotating to poster ${nextIndex + 1}/${window.arPosters.length}: ${nextPoster.title}`);
        
        // Quick switch without full scene recreation for speed
        await quickSwitchPoster(nextIndex);
        
    }, SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL);
    
    console.log(`✅ Scanner started (interval: ${SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL}ms)`);
}

// Stop the rotating scanner completely
function stopRotatingScanner() {
    if (scannerInterval) {
        clearInterval(scannerInterval);
        scannerInterval = null;
        console.log('🛑 Scanner stopped');
    }
}

// Pause the scanner (when poster detected)
function pauseRotatingScanner() {
    scannerPaused = true;
    console.log('⏸️ Scanner paused - poster detected!');
}

// Resume the scanner (when poster lost)
function resumeRotatingScanner() {
    if (!scannerInterval) {
        // Scanner was stopped, restart it
        startRotatingScanner();
    } else {
        scannerPaused = false;
        console.log('▶️ Scanner resumed - searching for posters...');
    }
}

// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// This is faster than full scene recreation - just swaps the imageTargetSrc
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!scene) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No AR scene found for quick switch');
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // Get MindAR system
        const mindarSystem = scene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
        
        if (mindarSystem) {
            // Stop current tracking
            await mindarSystem.stop();
            
            // Update the marker path
            window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
            window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
            
            // Update scene attribute
            scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${newPoster.mindPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 5; missTolerance: 10;`);
            
            // Update layers for the new poster
            updateLayersForPoster(newPoster);
            
            // Restart tracking
            await mindarSystem.start();
            
            console.log(`✅ Quick switched to: ${newPoster.title}`);
            return true;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch failed, doing full switch:', e);
        // Fall back to full scene recreation
        await switchToPoster(newPoster.id);
    }
    
    return false;
}

// Update the AR layers for a different poster (without recreating scene)
function updateLayersForPoster(poster) {
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    if (!target) return;
    
    // Update target's poster ID
    target.setAttribute('data-poster-id', poster.id);
    
    // Remove existing layers (except layer-0 black background)
    for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
        const existingLayer = document.getElementById(`ar-layer-${i}`);
        if (existingLayer) {
            existingLayer.remove();
        }
    }
    
    // Add new layers from poster data
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                
                const layer = document.createElement('a-plane');
                layer.setAttribute('id', `ar-layer-${i}`);
                layer.setAttribute('src', imagePath);
                layer.setAttribute('position', `0 0 ${zPos}`);
                layer.setAttribute('height', '1.4');
                layer.setAttribute('width', '1');
                layer.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
                layer.setAttribute('material', 'transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;');
                
                if (layerData.exclusion_filter) {
                    layer.setAttribute('data-exclusion', 'true');
                }
                
                target.appendChild(layer);
            }
        }
    }
    
    console.log(`📋 Layers updated for: ${poster.title}`);
}
```

// Switch to a different poster's AR marker
// This destroys the current scene and creates a new one with the selected poster
async function switchToPoster(posterId) {
    console.log('🔄 Switching to poster:', posterId);
    
    // Stop the rotating scanner during manual switch
    stopRotatingScanner();
    
    if (!window.arPosters) {
        console.error('❌ No AR posters available');
        return false;
    }
    
    // Find the poster by ID
    const posterIndex = window.arPosters.findIndex(p => p.id == posterId);
    if (posterIndex === -1) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Poster not found in AR posters:', posterId);
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    console.log('🎯 Switching to:', newPoster.title, '→', newPoster.mindPath);
    
    // Remove existing AR scene
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    if (existingScene) {
        // Stop MindAR first
        try {
            const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
            if (mindarSystem) {
                await mindarSystem.stop();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('⚠️ Could not stop MindAR:', e);
        }
        existingScene.remove();
        console.log('🗑️ Removed existing AR scene');
    }
    
    // Update global state
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
```

function resumeRotatingScanner() {
    if (!scannerInterval) {
        // Scanner was stopped, restart it
        startRotatingScanner();
    } else {
        scannerPaused = false;
        console.log('▶️ Scanner resumed - searching for posters...');

// Update the scanning indicator UI
function updateScanningIndicator(poster, index, total) {
    let indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    
    // Create indicator if it doesn't exist
    if (!indicator) {
        indicator = document.createElement('div');
        indicator.id = 'scanning-indicator';
        indicator.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            top: 60px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            color: white;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            z-index: 10000;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        `;
        document.body.appendChild(indicator);
    }
    
    indicator.textContent = `Scanning: ${poster.title} (${index + 1}/${total})`;
    indicator.style.opacity = '1';
}

// Hide the scanning indicator
function hideScanningIndicator() {
    const indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    if (indicator) {
        indicator.style.opacity = '0';
    }
}

// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// This is faster than full scene recreation - just swaps the imageTargetSrc
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];

// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// IMPROVED: Keeps camera running, only reloads the target compiler data
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    if (!scene) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No AR scene found for quick switch');
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // Get MindAR system
        const mindarSystem = scene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
        
        if (mindarSystem && mindarSystem.controller) {
            const controller = mindarSystem.controller;
            
            // Get preloaded data if available
            const preloaded = preloadedMindData.get(newPoster.id);
            
            // Update global state
            window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
            window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
            
            // Method: Stop tracking briefly, swap target, restart
            // This is faster than full scene recreation
            controller.stopProcessVideo();
            
            // Load new target data
            if (preloaded && preloaded.data) {
                // Use preloaded ArrayBuffer directly
                const compiler = new MINDAR.IMAGE.Compiler();
                const dataList = await compiler.importData(preloaded.data);
                controller.imageTargetSrc = newPoster.mindPath;
                controller._targetImages = dataList;
                console.log(`⚡ Using preloaded data for: ${newPoster.title}`);
            } else {
                // Fallback: load from URL
                await controller.addImageTargets(newPoster.mindPath);
                console.log(`📥 Loaded from URL: ${newPoster.title}`);
            }
            
            // Update layers for the new poster
            updateLayersForPoster(newPoster);
            
            // Resume video processing (camera stays on!)
            controller.processVideo(controller.video);
            
            console.log(`✅ Quick switched to: ${newPoster.title} (camera preserved)`);
            return true;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch method failed:', e.message);
        // Fallback: try simpler approach - just update layers and hope current target matches
        window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
        updateLayersForPoster(newPoster);
    }
    
    return false;
}

// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// Strategy: Pause tracking, swap imageTargetSrc, resume - keeps video running
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    if (!scene) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No AR scene found for quick switch');
        return false;
    }
    
    // Update global state first
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    // Update layers for the new poster (do this regardless of method)
    updateLayersForPoster(newPoster);
    
    try {
        // Get MindAR system
        const mindarSystem = scene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
        
        if (mindarSystem) {
            // Access the underlying controller
            const controller = mindarSystem.controller;
            
            if (controller) {
                // Try to use internal method to swap targets without camera restart
                // MindAR controller has video processing that can be paused
                
                // Option 1: If controller has intrim pause method
                if (typeof controller.interimsController?.stopProcessVideo === 'function') {
                    controller.interimsController.stopProcessVideo();
                    // Swap target
                    controller.imageTargetSrc = newPoster.mindPath;
                    // Resume
                    controller.interimsController.processVideo();
                    console.log(`✅ Switched via interim controller: ${newPoster.title}`);
                    return true;
                }
                
                // Option 2: Direct controller manipulation
                if (controller.processingVideo !== undefined) {
                    // Flag to pause processing
                    controller.processingVideo = false;
                    
                    // Brief pause for buffer clear
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));
                    
                    // Resume with same video element
                    controller.processingVideo = true;
                    
                    console.log(`✅ Switched via processing flag: ${newPoster.title}`);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            
            // Fallback: Use standard stop/start but it may flicker
            // Only do this occasionally to reduce flicker
            console.log(`⚠️ Using fallback switch for: ${newPoster.title}`);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch error:', e.message);
    }
    
    // Even if MindAR switch fails, layers are updated
    // The current .mind file will still try to detect something
    console.log(`📋 Layers ready for: ${newPoster.title}`);
    return true;

// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// IMPROVED: Keeps camera running, only reloads the target compiler data
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    if (!scene) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No AR scene found for quick switch');
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // Get MindAR system
        const mindarSystem = scene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
        
        if (mindarSystem && mindarSystem.controller) {
            const controller = mindarSystem.controller;
            
            // Get preloaded data if available
            const preloaded = preloadedMindData.get(newPoster.id);
            
            // Update global state
            window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
            window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
            
            // Method: Stop tracking briefly, swap target, restart
            // This is faster than full scene recreation
            controller.stopProcessVideo();
            
            // Load new target data
            if (preloaded && preloaded.data) {
                // Use preloaded ArrayBuffer directly
                const compiler = new MINDAR.IMAGE.Compiler();
                const dataList = await compiler.importData(preloaded.data);
                controller.imageTargetSrc = newPoster.mindPath;
                controller._targetImages = dataList;
                console.log(`⚡ Using preloaded data for: ${newPoster.title}`);
            } else {
                // Fallback: load from URL
                await controller.addImageTargets(newPoster.mindPath);
                console.log(`📥 Loaded from URL: ${newPoster.title}`);
            }
            
            // Update layers for the new poster
            updateLayersForPoster(newPoster);
            
            // Resume video processing (camera stays on!)
            controller.processVideo(controller.video);
            
            console.log(`✅ Quick switched to: ${newPoster.title} (camera preserved)`);
            return true;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch method failed:', e.message);
        // Fallback: try simpler approach - just update layers and hope current target matches
        window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
        updateLayersForPoster(newPoster);
    }
    
    return false;
}

// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// Strategy: Full scene swap but preserve camera stream to reduce flicker
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No AR scene found');
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // Get the video element BEFORE destroying the scene
        const existingVideo = existingScene.querySelector('video');
        let videoStream = null;
        
        if (existingVideo && existingVideo.srcObject) {
            // Capture the stream to reuse
            videoStream = existingVideo.srcObject;
            console.log('📹 Captured video stream for reuse');
        }
        
        // Get MindAR system and stop it gracefully
        const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
        if (mindarSystem) {
            try {
                // Don't call stop() - it releases the camera
                // Just pause processing
                if (mindarSystem.controller) {
                    mindarSystem.controller.processingVideo = false;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('⚠️ Could not pause MindAR:', e);
            }
        }
        
        // Remove old scene
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Create new scene HTML for the new poster
        const currentPoster = newPoster;
        let layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(currentPoster);
        
        const sceneHTML = `
            <a-scene
                id="ar-scene"
                mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${newPoster.mindPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 2; missTolerance: 5;"
                color-space="sRGB"
                renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
                vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
                
                <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
                
                <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${currentPoster.id}">
                    ${layersHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-scene>
        `;
        
        // Add new scene
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
        
        // Setup event listeners on new scene
        const newScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
        setupSceneEventListeners(newScene, currentPoster);
        
        // Reapply video filter after scene loads
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 300);
        
        console.log(`✅ Switched to: ${newPoster.title}`);
        return true;
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch error:', e.message);
        return false;
    }
}

// Build layers HTML for a poster
function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 0.05" 
            height="1.4" 
            width="1" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-plane 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        height="1.4" 
                        width="1" 
                        rotation="0 0 0"
                        ${materialAttr}
                        ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}

// Setup event listeners for AR scene
function setupSceneEventListeners(scene, currentPoster) {
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready for:', currentPoster.title);
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) loader.classList.add('hidden');
        
        // Apply video filter
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 200);
    });
    
    scene.addEventListener('arError', (event) => {
        console.error('❌ MindAR error:', event);
    });
    
    if (target) {
        target.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
            console.log(`🎯 TARGET FOUND! ${currentPoster.title}`);
            
            // Hide scan frame and camera
            const scanFrame = document.getElementById('scan-frame');
            if (scanFrame) scanFrame.classList.add('hidden');
            
            document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.opacity = '0';
            });
            
            // PAUSE scanner
            pauseRotatingScanner();
            lastDetectedPosterIndex = window.currentARPosterIndex;
            
            // Update UI
            currentTrackedPoster = currentPoster;
            showDetectedPosterState(currentPoster);
        });
        
        target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
            console.log(`🚫 TARGET LOST! ${currentPoster.title}`);
            
            // Show scan frame and camera
            const scanFrame = document.getElementById('scan-frame');
            if (scanFrame) scanFrame.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.opacity = '1';
            });
            
            hideDetectedPosterState();
            currentTrackedPoster = null;
            
            // RESUME scanner
            resumeRotatingScanner();
        });
    }
}

// Process exclusion filter layers (black→red, white→black)
function processExclusionFilters() {
    const exclusionLayers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-exclusion="true"]');
    exclusionLayers.forEach(layer => {
        const imgSrc = layer.getAttribute('src');
        const img = new Image();
        img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
        img.onload = () => {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = img.width;
            canvas.height = img.height;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
            
            const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            const data = imageData.data;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
                const luminance = (data[i] + data[i + 1] + data[i + 2]) / 3;
                const factor = 1 - (luminance / 255);
                data[i] = Math.round(175 * factor);     // R
                data[i + 1] = Math.round(29 * factor);  // G
                data[i + 2] = Math.round(31 * factor);  // B
            }
            
            ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
            
            const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
            texture.needsUpdate = true;
            
            const material = layer.getObject3D('mesh')?.material;
            if (material) {
                material.map = texture;
                material.needsUpdate = true;
                console.log('✅ Exclusion filter applied to:', layer.id);
            }
        };
        img.src = imgSrc;
    });
}

// Inject gallery overlay styles
function injectGalleryStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById('gallery-main-styles')) return;
    
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'gallery-main-styles';
    style.textContent = `
        #gallery-overlay { background: #af1d1f !important; }
        .overlay-header { background: #af1d1f !important; padding: 14px 20px !important; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important; }
        #gallery-overlay-grid { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 2rem !important; padding: 1.5rem !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card { display: block !important; background: transparent !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card:active { opacity: 0.7 !important; transform: scale(0.98) !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card img { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block !important; border: none !important; }
        .overlay-poster-card h3 { padding: 10px 0 0 0 !important; font-size: 0.95rem !important; font-weight: 400 !important; color: #000 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
        .overlay-title { font-size: 1rem !important; font-weight: 500 !important; color: #000 !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; }
        .close-overlay-btn { background: transparent !important; color: #000 !important; font-size: 1.8rem !important; width: 40px !important; height: 40px !important; }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
}

// ==================== STATIC CAMERA FEED SYSTEM ====================
// Creates a static camera feed that overlays the AR scene
// This hides the flickering from MindAR scene switches
// When a poster is detected, we fade out the static feed to reveal AR content

async function initializeStaticCameraFeed() {
    console.log('📹 Initializing static camera feed overlay...');
    
    try {
        // Request camera access
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            video: { 
                facingMode: 'environment',
                width: { ideal: 1920 },
                height: { ideal: 1080 }
            }
        });
        
        staticCameraStream = stream;
        
        // Create static video element overlay
        const staticVideo = document.createElement('video');
        staticVideo.id = 'static-camera-feed';
        staticVideo.srcObject = stream;
        staticVideo.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
        staticVideo.setAttribute('autoplay', '');
        staticVideo.muted = true;
        staticVideo.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            object-fit: cover;
            z-index: 9997;
            filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1);
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
            pointer-events: none;
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(staticVideo);
        await staticVideo.play();
        
        console.log('✅ Static camera feed ready (overlay for hidden AR scanner)');
        arSceneHidden = true;
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Could not create static camera feed:', error);
        // Continue without static feed - user will see some flicker
        arSceneHidden = false;
    }
}

// Reveal the AR scene (hide static feed) - called when poster detected
function revealARScene() {
    const staticFeed = document.getElementById('static-camera-feed');
    if (staticFeed) {
        staticFeed.style.opacity = '0';
        // Hide completely after transition
        setTimeout(() => {
            staticFeed.style.display = 'none';
        }, 300);
    }
    
    // Show AR scene videos
    document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach(v => {
        v.style.opacity = '0'; // Hide AR camera too, just show AR content
    });
    
    arSceneHidden = false;
    console.log('🎬 AR scene revealed!');
}

// Hide the AR scene (show static feed) - called when poster lost
function hideARScene() {
    const staticFeed = document.getElementById('static-camera-feed');
    if (staticFeed) {
        staticFeed.style.display = 'block';
        // Small delay to ensure display:block is applied before opacity transition
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            staticFeed.style.opacity = '1';
        });
    }
    
    // Show AR scene videos again (for MindAR to work)
    document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach(v => {
        v.style.opacity = '1';
        v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
    });
    
    arSceneHidden = true;
    console.log('🙈 AR scene hidden behind static feed');
}

// Custom smoothing for AR content - reduces jitter significantly

// Setup event listeners for AR scene
function setupSceneEventListeners(scene, currentPoster) {
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ MindAR ready for:', currentPoster.title);
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) loader.classList.add('hidden');
        
        // Apply video filter to AR scene video (behind static feed)
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 200);
    });
    
    scene.addEventListener('arError', (event) => {
        console.error('❌ MindAR error:', event);
    });
    
    if (target) {
        target.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
            console.log(`🎯 TARGET FOUND! ${currentPoster.title}`);
            
            // REVEAL AR SCENE - fade out static camera feed
            revealARScene();
            
            // Hide scan frame
            const scanFrame = document.getElementById('scan-frame');
            if (scanFrame) scanFrame.classList.add('hidden');
            
            // PAUSE scanner - we found a poster!
            pauseRotatingScanner();
            lastDetectedPosterIndex = window.currentARPosterIndex;
            
            // Update UI
            currentTrackedPoster = currentPoster;
            showDetectedPosterState(currentPoster);
        });
        
        target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
            console.log(`🚫 TARGET LOST! ${currentPoster.title}`);
            
            // HIDE AR SCENE - show static camera feed again
            hideARScene();
            
            // Show scan frame
            const scanFrame = document.getElementById('scan-frame');
            if (scanFrame) scanFrame.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            hideDetectedPosterState();
            currentTrackedPoster = null;
            
            // RESUME scanner - look for other posters
            resumeRotatingScanner();
        });
    }
}

// OPTIMIZED: Fast switching behind static camera feed - no flicker visible!
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }

    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;

        return false;
    }
    
    try {

        // Create minimal scene for fast loading
        const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(newPoster);

                id="ar-scene"

                color-space="sRGB"
                renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
                vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"

                <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
                
                <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${newPoster.id}">
                    ${layersHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-scene>
        `;
        
        // Add new scene
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
        
        // Setup event listeners on new scene
        const newScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
        setupSceneEventListeners(newScene, newPoster);
        
        // Apply video filter (hidden behind static feed anyway)
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 100);
        
        return true;
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch error:', e.message);
        return false;
    }
}

// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// Strategy: Full scene swap but preserve camera stream to reduce flicker
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        console.warn('⚠️ No AR scene found');
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // Get the video element BEFORE destroying the scene
        const existingVideo = existingScene.querySelector('video');
        let videoStream = null;
        
        if (existingVideo && existingVideo.srcObject) {
            // Capture the stream to reuse
            videoStream = existingVideo.srcObject;
            console.log('📹 Captured video stream for reuse');
        }
        
        // Get MindAR system and stop it gracefully
        const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems['mindar-image-system'];
        if (mindarSystem) {
            try {
                // Don't call stop() - it releases the camera
                // Just pause processing
                if (mindarSystem.controller) {
                    mindarSystem.controller.processingVideo = false;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('⚠️ Could not pause MindAR:', e);
            }
        }
        
        // Remove old scene
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Create new scene HTML for the new poster
        const currentPoster = newPoster;
        let layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(currentPoster);
        
        const sceneHTML = `
            <a-scene
                id="ar-scene"
                mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${newPoster.mindPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 2; missTolerance: 5;"
                color-space="sRGB"
                renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
                vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
                
                <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
                
                <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${currentPoster.id}">
                    ${layersHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-scene>
        `;
        
        // Add new scene
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
        
        // Setup event listeners on new scene
        const newScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
        setupSceneEventListeners(newScene, currentPoster);
        
        // Reapply video filter after scene loads
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            allVideos.forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 300);
        
        console.log(`✅ Switched to: ${newPoster.title}`);
        return true;
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch error:', e.message);
        return false;
    }
}

// Update the scanning indicator UI (subtle progress bar at bottom)
function updateScanningIndicator(poster, index, total) {
    let indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    
    // Create indicator if it doesn't exist
    if (!indicator) {
        indicator = document.createElement('div');
        indicator.id = 'scanning-indicator';
        indicator.innerHTML = `
            <div class="scan-progress-bar">
                <div class="scan-progress-fill"></div>
            </div>
            <span class="scan-text">Scanning...</span>
        `;
        indicator.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 80px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            color: white;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 11px;
            z-index: 10000;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
        `;
        
        // Add progress bar styles
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'scan-indicator-styles';
        style.textContent = `
            .scan-progress-bar {
                width: 60px;
                height: 4px;
                background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
                border-radius: 2px;
                overflow: hidden;
            }
            .scan-progress-fill {
                height: 100%;
                background: #af1d1f;
                border-radius: 2px;
                transition: width 0.15s ease;
            }
        `;
        if (!document.getElementById('scan-indicator-styles')) {
            document.head.appendChild(style);
        }
        
        document.body.appendChild(indicator);
    }
    
    // Update progress bar
    const progressFill = indicator.querySelector('.scan-progress-fill');
    const scanText = indicator.querySelector('.scan-text');
    if (progressFill) {
        const progress = ((index + 1) / total) * 100;
        progressFill.style.width = progress + '%';
    }
    if (scanText) {
        scanText.textContent = `${index + 1}/${total}`;
    }
    
    indicator.style.opacity = '1';
}

// Hide the scanning indicator
function hideScanningIndicator() {
    const indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    if (indicator) {
        indicator.style.opacity = '0';
    }
}

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Dynamic single-poster loading
// HIDDEN SCANNER: Scene runs behind static camera feed until poster detected
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene (hidden scanner mode)...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath || !window.arPosters) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path or posters available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // Get the current poster to display
    const currentPoster = window.arPosters[window.currentARPosterIndex || 0];
    console.log('🎯 Loading AR for poster:', currentPoster.title);
    
    // Build layers HTML using helper function
    const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(currentPoster);
    
    // Create scene with single target - faster warmup for rotation
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 1; missTolerance: 3;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${currentPoster.id}">
                ${layersHTML}
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Hidden AR scene added for poster:', currentPoster.title);
    
    // Get reference to scene
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    // Setup event listeners using helper function
    setupSceneEventListeners(scene, currentPoster);
    
    // Additional setup for first load
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ Hidden AR scanner ready');
        
        // Process exclusion filter layers
        setTimeout(() => {
            processExclusionFilters();
        }, 1000);
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) loader.classList.add('hidden');
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to AR scene videos
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 200);
    });
    
    // Setup swipe bar controls
    setupSwipeBarControls();
    
    // Setup gallery overlay
    setupGalleryOverlay();
    
    // Force gallery overlay styles
    injectGalleryStyles();
    
    console.log('✅ AR scene initialized (hidden behind static feed)');
}

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - Dynamic single-poster loading
// Each poster has its own .mind file, we load one at a time
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene (dynamic mode)...');
    
    if (!window.arMarkerPath || !window.arPosters) {
        console.error('❌ No AR marker path or posters available!');
        return;

    console.log('🎯 Loading AR for poster:', currentPoster.title);
    console.log('📋 Using .mind file:', window.arMarkerPath);
    
    // Build layers HTML using helper function
    const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(currentPoster);
    
    // Create scene with single target - faster warmup for rotation
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${window.arMarkerPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 2; missTolerance: 5;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${currentPoster.id}">
                ${layersHTML}
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Scene added for poster:', currentPoster.title);
    
    // Get reference to scene
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    // Setup event listeners using helper function
    setupSceneEventListeners(scene, currentPoster);
    
    // Additional setup for first load
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        // Process exclusion filter layers
        setTimeout(() => {
            processExclusionFilters();
        }, 1000);

}

function revealARScene() {
    const staticFeed = document.getElementById('static-camera-feed');
    if (staticFeed) {
        staticFeed.style.opacity = '0';
        // Hide completely after transition
        setTimeout(() => {
            staticFeed.style.display = 'none';
        }, 300);
    }
    
    // Hide ALL video elements (both static feed and AR scene videos)
    // The black background layer (ar-layer-0) will show instead
    document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(v => {
        v.style.opacity = '0';
    });
    
    // Ensure the AR scene canvas is visible for 3D content
    const arScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    if (arScene) {
        const canvas = arScene.querySelector('canvas');
        if (canvas) {
            canvas.style.opacity = '1';
            canvas.style.visibility = 'visible';
        }
    }

// Build layers HTML for a poster
function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer - BEHIND all other layers (negative Z)
    // Make it larger than the poster to cover any gaps
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 -0.01" 
            height="2" 
            width="1.5" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-plane 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        height="1.4" 
                        width="1" 
                        rotation="0 0 0"
                        ${materialAttr}
                        ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
            }
        }
    }
```

// SAFE VERSION: Properly waits for MindAR cleanup to prevent WebGL context overflow
let isSwitching = false; // Prevent concurrent switches

async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    // Prevent concurrent switches
    if (isSwitching) {
        return false;
    }
    
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    isSwitching = true;
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        isSwitching = false;
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // PROPERLY stop MindAR before removing scene
        const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems?.['mindar-image-system'];
        if (mindarSystem && mindarSystem.controller) {
            try {
                // Gracefully stop MindAR
                mindarSystem.controller.processingVideo = false;
                if (mindarSystem.video) {
                    mindarSystem.video.pause();
                }
            } catch (e) {
                // Ignore errors during cleanup
            }
        }
        
        // Wait a bit for cleanup
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
        
        // Now safely remove the scene
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Wait for DOM cleanup
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
        
        // Create new scene
        const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(newPoster);
        
        const sceneHTML = `
            <a-scene
                id="ar-scene"
                mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${newPoster.mindPath}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 1; missTolerance: 3;"
                color-space="sRGB"
                renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
                vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
                
                <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
                
                <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${newPoster.id}">
                    ${layersHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-scene>
        `;
        
        // Add new scene
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
        
        // Setup event listeners
        const newScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
        setupSceneEventListeners(newScene, newPoster);
        
        // Apply video filter
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 100);
        
        isSwitching = false;
        return true;
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Quick switch error:', e.message);
        isSwitching = false;
        return false;
    }
} oldString:// Quick switch to another poster's .mind file
// OPTIMIZED: Fast switching behind static camera feed - no flicker visible!
async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator (subtle, behind static feed)
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // Quickly remove old scene (flicker hidden behind static feed)
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Create minimal scene for fast loading
        const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(newPoster);
        
        const sceneHTML = `
            <a-scene

                    ${layersHTML}
                </a-entity>
            </a-scene>
        `;
        
        // Add new scene
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
        
        // Setup event listeners on new scene
        const newScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
        setupSceneEventListeners(newScene, newPoster);
        
        // Apply video filter (hidden behind static feed anyway)
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 100);
        
        return true;
        
    } catch (e) {

        return false;
    }
}]]

# Enable CORS for all resources (AR/MindAR compatibility)
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    # FORCE CORS for ALL requests - critical for MindAR
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Origin "*"
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Methods "GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD"
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Headers "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With, Range"
    
    # Remove problematic headers that block loading
    Header unset Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy
    Header unset Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy
    
    # DISABLE CACHING for development - remove this in production!
    <FilesMatch "\.(html|css|js)$">
        Header set Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
        Header set Pragma "no-cache"
        Header set Expires 0
    </FilesMatch>
    
    # Specific CORS for images and AR resources
    <FilesMatch "\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|svg|mind|fset|fset3|iset)$">
        Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Origin "*"
    </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

# Handle OPTIONS preflight requests
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} OPTIONS
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ $1 [R=200,L]
```

// ==================== SMART PARALLEL SCANNER SYSTEM ====================
// Uses multiple detection approaches for faster poster detection:
// 1. Rapid sequential switching (500ms intervals)
// 2. "Sticky detection" - when partial match found, stay longer
// 3. Smart prioritization based on recent detections

// Tracking for smart detection
let posterDetectionScores = new Map(); // posterIndex -> score (0-100)
let lastPartialDetection = -1;
let consecutiveNoDetection = 0;
const PARTIAL_DETECTION_THRESHOLD = 0.3; // 30% confidence = partial match

// Start the rotating scanner
function startRotatingScanner() {
    if (scannerInterval) {
        console.log('⚠️ Scanner already running');
        return;
    }
    
    if (!window.arPosters || window.arPosters.length <= 1) {
        console.log('📌 Not enough posters for rotation');
        return;
    }
    
    // Initialize detection scores
    window.arPosters.forEach((_, i) => posterDetectionScores.set(i, 0));
    
    console.log(`🔄 Starting SMART scanner for ${window.arPosters.length} posters (${SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL}ms base interval)`);
    scannerPaused = false;
    
    // Use dynamic interval based on detection state
    const runScanner = async () => {
        if (scannerPaused) {
            scannerInterval = setTimeout(runScanner, SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL);
            return;
        }
        
        // Get next poster index (smart selection)
        const nextIndex = getSmartNextPosterIndex();
        await quickSwitchPoster(nextIndex);
        
        // Dynamic interval: faster if nothing detected, slower if partial match
        let nextInterval = SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL;
        if (lastPartialDetection === nextIndex) {
            // Stay longer on partial match
            nextInterval = SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL * 2;
            console.log(`🔍 Partial match on poster ${nextIndex}, staying longer...`);
        } else if (consecutiveNoDetection > window.arPosters.length) {
            // Speed up if we've scanned all without detection
            nextInterval = Math.max(400, SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL - 200);
        }
        
        scannerInterval = setTimeout(runScanner, nextInterval);
    };
    
    scannerInterval = setTimeout(runScanner, SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL);
}

// Smart poster selection - prioritizes posters with higher detection scores
function getSmartNextPosterIndex() {
    const totalPosters = window.arPosters.length;
    const currentIndex = window.currentARPosterIndex;
    
    // If we had a partial detection recently, check that one again
    if (lastPartialDetection >= 0 && lastPartialDetection !== currentIndex) {
        const lastScore = posterDetectionScores.get(lastPartialDetection) || 0;
        if (lastScore > 20) {
            return lastPartialDetection;
        }
    }
    
    // Otherwise, round-robin with slight preference for higher-scored posters
    let nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % totalPosters;
    
    // Check if any poster has a high score (recent partial detection)
    let highestScore = 0;
    let highestIndex = nextIndex;
    
    posterDetectionScores.forEach((score, index) => {
        if (score > highestScore && index !== currentIndex) {
            highestScore = score;
            highestIndex = index;
        }
    });
    
    // If there's a significantly higher scored poster, check that one
    if (highestScore > 30) {
        return highestIndex;
    }
    
    return nextIndex;
}

// Update detection score for a poster (called from MindAR tracking)
function updatePosterDetectionScore(posterIndex, confidence) {
    const currentScore = posterDetectionScores.get(posterIndex) || 0;
    
    if (confidence > PARTIAL_DETECTION_THRESHOLD) {
        // Boost score for partial detection
        posterDetectionScores.set(posterIndex, Math.min(100, currentScore + 30));
        lastPartialDetection = posterIndex;
        consecutiveNoDetection = 0;
    } else {
        // Decay score over time
        posterDetectionScores.set(posterIndex, Math.max(0, currentScore - 10));
        consecutiveNoDetection++;
    }
}

// Decay all scores periodically (prevents stale scores)
function decayAllScores() {
    posterDetectionScores.forEach((score, index) => {
        posterDetectionScores.set(index, Math.max(0, score - 5));
    });
}

// Start the rotating scanner
function startRotatingScanner() {
    if (scannerInterval) {

        return;

    if (!window.arPosters || window.arPosters.length <= 1) {

// OPTIMIZED VERSION: Uses preloaded .mind data as Blob URLs for faster loading
let isSwitching = false; // Prevent concurrent switches
let mindBlobUrls = new Map(); // Cache blob URLs for preloaded .mind files

// Create blob URLs from preloaded data (called once after preloading)
function createMindBlobUrls() {
    preloadedMindData.forEach((data, posterId) => {
        if (data.data && !mindBlobUrls.has(posterId)) {
            const blob = new Blob([data.data], { type: 'application/octet-stream' });
            const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            mindBlobUrls.set(posterId, blobUrl);
            console.log(`🔗 Created blob URL for poster ${posterId}`);
        }
    });
}

async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    // Prevent concurrent switches
    if (isSwitching) {
        return false;
    }
    
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    isSwitching = true;
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    // Use blob URL if available (faster), otherwise fall back to file path
    const blobUrl = mindBlobUrls.get(newPoster.id);
    window.arMarkerPath = blobUrl || newPoster.mindPath;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        isSwitching = false;
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // FAST CLEANUP: Stop MindAR processing immediately
        const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems?.['mindar-image-system'];
        if (mindarSystem) {
            if (mindarSystem.controller) {
                mindarSystem.controller.processingVideo = false;
            }
            if (mindarSystem.video) {
                mindarSystem.video.pause();
            }
        }
        
        // Quick wait for cleanup (reduced from 100ms)
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
        
        // Remove existing scene
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Minimal DOM cleanup wait (reduced from 50ms)
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 30));

// SAFE VERSION: Properly waits for MindAR cleanup to prevent WebGL context overflow
let isSwitching = false; // Prevent concurrent switches

async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    // Prevent concurrent switches
    if (isSwitching) {
        return false;
    }
    
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    isSwitching = true;
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.arMarkerPath = newPoster.mindPath;
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        isSwitching = false;
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // PROPERLY stop MindAR before removing scene
        const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems?.['mindar-image-system'];
        if (mindarSystem && mindarSystem.controller) {
            try {
                // Gracefully stop MindAR
                mindarSystem.controller.processingVideo = false;
                if (mindarSystem.video) {
                    mindarSystem.video.pause();
                }
            } catch (e) {
                // Ignore errors during cleanup
            }
        }
        
        // Wait a bit for cleanup
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
        
        // Now safely remove the scene
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Wait for DOM cleanup
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));

// WebGL context management - prevents context overflow
let lastWebGLContext = null;

const MAX_WEBGL_CONTEXTS = 6; // Safe limit for mobile devices

// Static camera feed overlay (hides the flickering AR scene)
let staticCameraStream = null;

// Force cleanup of WebGL contexts to prevent overflow
function cleanupWebGLContexts() {
    // Force garbage collection hint
    if (lastWebGLContext) {
        try {
            lastWebGLContext.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')?.loseContext();
        } catch (e) {

    }

}

// ==================== SMART PARALLEL SCANNER SYSTEM ====================
// Uses multiple detection approaches for faster poster detection:
// 1. Rapid sequential switching (600ms intervals)
// 2. "Sticky detection" - when partial match found, stay longer
// 3. Smart prioritization based on recent detections
// 4. Pre-built scene HTML for instant loading

// Tracking for smart detection
let posterDetectionScores = new Map(); // posterIndex -> score (0-100)
let lastPartialDetection = -1;
let consecutiveNoDetection = 0;
const PARTIAL_DETECTION_THRESHOLD = 0.3; // 30% confidence = partial match

// Pre-built scene HTML cache for each poster
let prebuiltSceneHTML = new Map(); // posterId -> sceneHTML string

// Pre-build all scene HTML at startup for instant switching
function prebuildAllSceneHTML() {
    if (!window.arPosters) return;
    
    console.log('🏗️ Pre-building scene HTML for all posters...');
    window.arPosters.forEach((poster, index) => {
        const mindSrc = mindBlobUrls.get(poster.id) || poster.mindPath;
        const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(poster);
        
        const sceneHTML = `
            <a-scene
                id="ar-scene"
                mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${mindSrc}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 0; missTolerance: 2;"
                color-space="sRGB"
                renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"

function hideScanningIndicator() {
    const indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    if (indicator) {
        // Hide progress but keep button
        const progressContainer = indicator.querySelector('.scan-progress-container');
        if (progressContainer) {
            progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
        }
        // Reset button to SCAN state
        const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scan-button');
        if (scanBtn) {
            scanBtn.textContent = 'SCAN';
            scanBtn.classList.remove('scanning');
            scanBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    }
}

// Start scan cycles (triggered by button click)
function startScanCycles() {
    if (isScanning) return; // Already scanning
    
    console.log('🔍 Starting scan cycles...');
    isScanning = true;
    currentScanCycle = 0;
    postersScannedInCycle = 0;
    
    // Update button state
    const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scan-button');
    if (scanBtn) {
        scanBtn.textContent = 'SCANNING...';
        scanBtn.classList.add('scanning');
        scanBtn.disabled = true;
    }
    
    // Show progress container
    const progressContainer = document.querySelector('.scan-progress-container');
    if (progressContainer) {
        progressContainer.style.display = 'flex';
    }
    
    // Start the scanner
    startRotatingScanner();
}

// Stop scan cycles (called when cycles complete or poster found)
function stopScanCycles(reason = 'complete') {
    console.log(`🛑 Stopping scan cycles: ${reason}`);
    isScanning = false;
    currentScanCycle = 0;
    postersScannedInCycle = 0;
    
    // Stop the scanner
    stopRotatingScanner();
    
    // Reset UI
    hideScanningIndicator();
}

// Check if scan cycles are complete
function checkScanCycleComplete() {
    if (!isScanning) return;
    
    postersScannedInCycle++;
    
    // Check if we completed a full cycle
    if (postersScannedInCycle >= window.arPosters.length) {
        currentScanCycle++;
        postersScannedInCycle = 0;
        console.log(`📊 Completed cycle ${currentScanCycle}/${totalScanCycles}`);
        
        // Check if all cycles are done
        if (currentScanCycle >= totalScanCycles) {
            console.log('✅ All scan cycles complete!');
            stopScanCycles('complete');
        }
    }
} oldString:// Hide the scanning indicator

    // Use dynamic interval based on detection state
    const runScanner = async () => {
        // Check if scanning should stop
        if (!isScanning) {
            return;
        }
        
        if (scannerPaused) {
            scannerInterval = setTimeout(runScanner, SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL);
            return;
        }
        
        // Get next poster index (smart selection)
        const nextIndex = getSmartNextPosterIndex();
        await quickSwitchPoster(nextIndex);
        
        // Track cycle progress
        checkScanCycleComplete();
        
        // Check if still scanning after cycle check
        if (!isScanning) {
            return;
        }
        
        // Dynamic interval: faster if nothing detected, slower if partial match
        let nextInterval = SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL;
        if (lastPartialDetection === nextIndex) {
            // Stay longer on partial match
            nextInterval = SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL * 2;
            console.log(`🔍 Partial match on poster ${nextIndex}, staying longer...`);
        } else if (consecutiveNoDetection > window.arPosters.length) {
            // Speed up if we've scanned all without detection
            nextInterval = Math.max(400, SCANNER_ROTATE_INTERVAL - 200);
        }
        
        scannerInterval = setTimeout(runScanner, nextInterval);
    };
```

// Update the scanning indicator UI - Simple: SCAN button or progress bar
function updateScanningIndicator(poster, index, total) {
    let indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    
    // Create indicator if it doesn't exist
    if (!indicator) {
        indicator = document.createElement('div');
        indicator.id = 'scanning-indicator';
        indicator.innerHTML = `
            <button id="scan-button" class="scan-btn">SCAN</button>
            <div class="scan-progress-container" style="display: none;">
                <div class="scan-progress-bar">
                    <div class="scan-progress-fill"></div>
                </div>
                <span class="scan-text">1/10</span>
            </div>
        `;
        indicator.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 80px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            color: white;
            padding: 10px 20px;
            border-radius: 25px;
            font-size: 13px;
            z-index: 10000;
        `;
        
        // Add styles
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'scan-indicator-styles';
        style.textContent = `
            .scan-btn {
                background: #af1d1f;
                color: white;
                border: none;
                padding: 10px 28px;
                border-radius: 20px;
                font-size: 14px;
                font-weight: bold;
                cursor: pointer;
            }
            .scan-progress-container {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 10px;
            }
            .scan-progress-bar {
                width: 100px;
                height: 8px;
                background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
                border-radius: 4px;
                overflow: hidden;
            }
            .scan-progress-fill {
                height: 100%;
                background: #af1d1f;
                border-radius: 4px;
                transition: width 0.1s ease;
            }
        `;
        if (!document.getElementById('scan-indicator-styles')) {
            document.head.appendChild(style);
        }
        
        document.body.appendChild(indicator);
        
        // Add click handler
        document.getElementById('scan-button').addEventListener('click', startScanCycles);
    }
    
    // Only update progress if scanning
    if (!isScanning) return;
    
    const progressFill = indicator.querySelector('.scan-progress-fill');
    const scanText = indicator.querySelector('.scan-text');
    
    if (progressFill) {
        const progress = ((index + 1) / total) * 100;
        progressFill.style.width = progress + '%';
    }
    if (scanText) {
        scanText.textContent = `${currentScanCycle + 1}/${totalScanCycles}`;
    }
}

// Update the scanning indicator UI with SCAN button
function updateScanningIndicator(poster, index, total) {
    let indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    
    // Create indicator if it doesn't exist
    if (!indicator) {
        indicator = document.createElement('div');
        indicator.id = 'scanning-indicator';
        indicator.innerHTML = `
            <button id="scan-button" class="scan-btn">SCAN</button>
            <div class="scan-progress-container" style="display: none;">
                <div class="scan-progress-bar">
                    <div class="scan-progress-fill"></div>
                </div>
                <span class="scan-text">1/10</span>
            </div>
        `;
        indicator.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 80px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            color: white;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 25px;
            font-size: 12px;
            z-index: 10000;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
        `;
        
        // Add progress bar and button styles
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'scan-indicator-styles';
        style.textContent = `
            .scan-btn {
                background: #af1d1f;
                color: white;
                border: none;
                padding: 10px 24px;
                border-radius: 20px;
                font-size: 14px;
                font-weight: bold;
                cursor: pointer;
                text-transform: uppercase;
                letter-spacing: 1px;
                transition: all 0.2s ease;
            }
            .scan-btn:hover {
                background: #8f1819;
                transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            .scan-btn:active {
                transform: scale(0.98);
            }
            .scan-btn.scanning {
                background: #666;
                cursor: not-allowed;
            }
            .scan-progress-container {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 8px;
            }
            .scan-progress-bar {
                width: 80px;
                height: 6px;
                background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
                border-radius: 3px;
                overflow: hidden;
            }
            .scan-progress-fill {
                height: 100%;
                background: #af1d1f;
                border-radius: 3px;
                transition: width 0.15s ease;
            }
            .scan-text {
                min-width: 45px;
                text-align: center;
            }
        `;
        if (!document.getElementById('scan-indicator-styles')) {
            document.head.appendChild(style);
        }
        
        document.body.appendChild(indicator);
        
        // Add click handler to scan button
        const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scan-button');
        if (scanBtn) {
            scanBtn.addEventListener('click', startScanCycles);
        }
    }
    
    // Only update progress if scanning is active
    if (!isScanning) return;
    
    // Update progress bar
    const progressContainer = indicator.querySelector('.scan-progress-container');
    const progressFill = indicator.querySelector('.scan-progress-fill');
    const scanText = indicator.querySelector('.scan-text');
    
    if (progressContainer) {
        progressContainer.style.display = 'flex';
    }
    
    if (progressFill) {
        // Progress shows cycle progress (which poster in current cycle)
        const progress = ((index + 1) / total) * 100;
        progressFill.style.width = progress + '%';
    }
    if (scanText) {
        // Show current cycle / total cycles
        scanText.textContent = `${currentScanCycle + 1}/${totalScanCycles}`;
    }
    
    indicator.style.opacity = '1';
}

// Hide progress, show SCAN button
function hideScanningIndicator() {
    const indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    if (indicator) {
        // Hide progress, show button
        const progressContainer = indicator.querySelector('.scan-progress-container');
        const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scan-button');
        if (progressContainer) progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
        if (scanBtn) scanBtn.style.display = 'block';
    }
}

// Start scan cycles (button click)
function startScanCycles() {
    if (isScanning) return;
    
    console.log('🔍 Starting scan...');
    isScanning = true;
    currentScanCycle = 0;
    postersScannedInCycle = 0;
    
    // Hide button, show progress
    const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scan-button');
    const progressContainer = document.querySelector('.scan-progress-container');
    if (scanBtn) scanBtn.style.display = 'none';
    if (progressContainer) progressContainer.style.display = 'flex';
    
    // Start scanner
    startRotatingScanner();
}

// Stop scan cycles
function stopScanCycles(reason = 'complete') {
    console.log(`🛑 Scan stopped: ${reason}`);
    isScanning = false;
    currentScanCycle = 0;
    postersScannedInCycle = 0;
    
    stopRotatingScanner();
    hideScanningIndicator();
}

// Hide the scanning indicator (but keep button visible)
function hideScanningIndicator() {
    const indicator = document.getElementById('scanning-indicator');
    if (indicator) {
        // Hide progress but keep button
        const progressContainer = indicator.querySelector('.scan-progress-container');
        if (progressContainer) {
            progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
        }
        // Reset button to SCAN state
        const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scan-button');
        if (scanBtn) {
            scanBtn.textContent = 'SCAN';
            scanBtn.classList.remove('scanning');
            scanBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    }
}

// Start scan cycles (triggered by button click)
function startScanCycles() {
    if (isScanning) return; // Already scanning
    
    console.log('🔍 Starting scan cycles...');
    isScanning = true;
    currentScanCycle = 0;
    postersScannedInCycle = 0;
    
    // Update button state
    const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scan-button');
    if (scanBtn) {
        scanBtn.textContent = 'SCANNING...';
        scanBtn.classList.add('scanning');
        scanBtn.disabled = true;
    }
    
    // Show progress container
    const progressContainer = document.querySelector('.scan-progress-container');
    if (progressContainer) {
        progressContainer.style.display = 'flex';
    }
    
    // Start the scanner
    startRotatingScanner();
}

// Stop scan cycles (called when cycles complete or poster found)
function stopScanCycles(reason = 'complete') {
    console.log(`🛑 Stopping scan cycles: ${reason}`);
    isScanning = false;
    currentScanCycle = 0;
    postersScannedInCycle = 0;
    
    // Stop the scanner
    stopRotatingScanner();
    
    // Reset UI
    hideScanningIndicator();
}
