_**Agent (copilot/gemini-3-pro-preview)**_

Dit is duidelijke feedback. We gaan voor **Brutalisme**, maar dan doordacht: het contrast tussen de "oude media" (krant/papier) en de "nieuwe media" (internet/data). Geen gimmicks, maar sfeer.

Hier is het herwerkte plan: **"The Digital Press"**.

### 1. Typografie: Krant vs. Terminal
Dit contrast is goud waard. We zetten een klassieke, gezaghebbende krantenletter tegenover een rauwe, monospaced systeemletter.

**Combo Voorstel 1: "The Anarchist" (Mijn favoriet)**
*   **Krant (Titels/Grote tekst):** [UnifrakturMaguntia](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/UnifrakturMaguntia). Een Blackletter font. Dit schreeuwt "oude krant", maar in een moderne context voelt het als een punk/metal statement (denk aan Thrasher magazine of oude protestpamfletten).
*   **Internet (Data/UI):** [Space Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Space+Mono). Een monospace font dat eruitziet als code of een typemachine.

**Combo Voorstel 2: "The Headline" (Strakker)**
*   **Krant:** [Prata](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Prata). Een elegante serif met hoog contrast (dikke en dunne lijnen). Doet denken aan Vogue of NYT, maar in het wit op zwart wordt het heel scherp en snijdend.
*   **Internet:** [JetBrains Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/JetBrains+Mono) of gewoon `Courier New`. Rauwe data.

### 2. De Layout: "The Grid is Broken"
Als alle posters dezelfde afmetingen hebben, is een standaard masonry grid inderdaad saai. Hoe maken we dit "activistisch"? Door de regels te breken.

*   **De "Offset" Grid:** We gebruiken CSS Grid, maar we laten de even kolommen zakken (verticale offset). Hierdoor krijg je geen rechte horizontale lijnen, wat het "muur"-gevoel breekt en dynamiek geeft.
*   **Dichtheid:** We zetten de posters *strak* tegen elkaar (gap: 0 of 1px). De scheiding wordt gemaakt door de posters zelf, of een flinterdunne rode lijn (`#af1d1f`) die alleen zichtbaar is als je goed kijkt.
*   **Grootte Variatie:** We kunnen via CSS willekeurige posters (bijv. elke 7e) dubbel zo groot maken (`grid-column: span 2; grid-row: span 2`). Dit doorbreekt de eentonigheid en geeft een hiërarchie van "belangrijk nieuws".

### 3. Sfeer & Textuur (Grunge zonder Gimmick)
*   **Achtergrond:** Diep donkergrijs (`#0a0a0a`).
*   **Noise Overlay:** We leggen een subtiele "film grain" over de *hele* website (via `pointer-events: none`). Dit maakt alles minder digitaal en steriel. Het voelt als geprint papier of ruis op een scherm.
*   **Logo:** De QR code blijft, maar we maken hem wit op zwart (geïnverteerd) of rood op zwart.

### 4. Interactie (Hover & Info)
Geen tags, geen stickers. We houden het strak en informatief.

*   **State:** Poster is full-color en zichtbaar.
*   **Hover:**
    *   De poster wordt iets donkerder (tint).
    *   De **Titel** verschijnt in het midden of linksonder in het **Krantenfont** (groot).
    *   De **Datum** en **Downloads** verschijnen klein in het **Internetfont** (monospaced) in de hoeken.
    *   Dit alles in wit, met misschien een harde zwarte achtergrond achter de tekst (zoals geselecteerde tekst).

Zullen we **Combo 1 (Blackletter + Mono)** proberen met de **Offset Grid**? Ik kan dit nu implementeren.

Ik zal beginnen met:
1.  Fonts importeren in `style.css`.
2.  De CSS variabelen updaten (kleuren).
3.  De "Noise" texture toevoegen.
4.  De Grid layout aanpassen.

Geef maar een seintje of ik mag starten

## **Herwerkt Plan: "The Black Archive"**

### 1. Typografie: Krant vs. Data

**KRANT = Autoriteit, Oud Nieuws, Serieus**
Ik zoek een font dat direct "voorpagina" schreeuwt. Geen magazines, geen fraktuur.

**Voorstel A: [Playfair Display](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Playfair+Display)**
*   Hoog contrast serif, geïnspireerd op 18e/19e eeuwse krantentitels.
*   Heel direct "The Times", "De Standaard" gevoel.

**Voorstel B: [DM Serif Display](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DM+Serif+Display)**
*   Strakker, moderner, maar nog steeds die "headline" autoriteit.

**Voorstel C: [Bodoni Moda](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Bodoni+Moda)**
*   Klassiek, scherp, snijdend. Denk aan oude persberichten.

---

**INTERNET = Data, Chaos, Trolls, Glitch**
Je wilt geen "mooie" code font. Je wilt iets dat voelt als een kapotte terminal, een error message, of een 4chan post.

**Voorstel A: [VT323](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/VT323)**
*   Letterlijk een oude CRT terminal font. Pixels, ruis, data.

**Voorstel B: [DotGothic16](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DotGothic16)**
*   Japanse 16-bit pixel font. Voelt als een oude arcade of early internet.

**Voorstel C: [Silkscreen](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Silkscreen)**
*   Ultra-low-res pixel font. Voelt als een systeem error.

**Voorstel D: [IBM Plex Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/IBM+Plex+Mono)**
*   Als je toch iets leesbaarders wilt, maar dan wel met die "corporate mainframe" sfeer.

---

### 2. De Grid: Kolossaal, niet Chaotisch

Je wilt **GROOT**. Monumentaal. Brutalistisch. Geen Pinterest-chaos.

**Plan: "The Monument Grid"**
*   **Weinig kolommen:** 2 of 3 kolommen max op desktop. De posters zijn *groot*.
*   **Strak tegen elkaar:** `gap: 0` of `gap: 1px` (een haardunne rode lijn als scheiding, `#af1d1f`).
*   **Full bleed:** De grid gaat van rand tot rand. Geen padding links/rechts.
*   **Consistente hoogte:** Alle posters dezelfde aspect ratio (A-formaat), geen variatie. Dit geeft rust en monumentaliteit.

Dit geeft het gevoel van een **archiefkast** of een **betonnen wand met ingelijste documenten**.

---

### 3. Kleur & Textuur

*   **Achtergrond:** `#000000` (puur zwart).
*   **Accent:** `#af1d1f` (jouw rood) – enkel voor hover, selectie, en dunne lijnen.
*   **Tekst:** `#ffffff` (wit) en `#af1d1f` (rood).
*   **Noise:** Een subtiele PNG overlay met film grain, `opacity: 0.03-0.05`, over de hele pagina. Dit breekt de digitale perfectie.

---

### 4. Hover Interactie

*   **Default:** Poster is zichtbaar, geen info.
*   **Hover:**
    *   Een semi-transparante zwarte overlay (`rgba(0,0,0,0.7)`).
    *   **Titel** verschijnt in het **Krantenfont** (groot, wit, linksonder of gecentreerd).
    *   **Datum** en **Downloads** verschijnen in het **Pixelfont** (klein, wit of rood, in een hoek).

---

### Mijn Aanrader Combo:

| Element | Font |
|---------|------|
| **Krant (Titels)** | **Bodoni Moda** of **Playfair Display** |
| **Internet (Data)** | **VT323** (pixelig, CRT) |

Dit geeft het contrast: de *autoriteit* van de oude pers vs. de *ruis* van het internet.

## **Finaal Plan: "The Black Archive"**

### 1. Typografie

| Rol | Font | Gebruik |
|-----|------|---------|
| **Krant (Titels)** | **Playfair Display** | Poster titels, grote statements |
| **Internet (Data)** | **???** | Datum, downloads, metadata, UI |
| **Accent (Glitch)** | **VT323** | Speciale momenten: error states, "CLASSIFIED", timestamps |

**Het ontbrekende Internet Font - Nieuwe voorstellen:**

Ik zoek iets dat schreeuwt: forums, early web, memes, copypasta, raw data.

**Voorstel A: [Roboto Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto+Mono)**
*   Het "Google Docs" / Android font. Zakelijk, koud, datagedreven. Geen persoonlijkheid = internet.

**Voorstel B: [Anonymous Pro](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Anonymous+Pro)**
*   Ontworpen voor anonimiteit en leesbaarheid. Past bij de "anonymous" cultuur.

**Voorstel C: [Fira Code](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Fira+Code)**
*   Developer font. Voelt als GitHub, Stack Overflow, code reviews.

**Voorstel D: [Inconsolata](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inconsolata)**
*   Heel neutraal, bijna klinisch. Pure data.

**Voorstel E: [Source Code Pro](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Source+Code+Pro)**
*   Adobe's code font. Strak, leesbaar, "official leak" vibes.

**Mijn suggestie:** **Roboto Mono** of **Inconsolata** - ze zijn zo *generiek* dat ze precies die koude internet-data sfeer geven. Of **Anonymous Pro** voor de symboliek.

---

### 2. Grid: 3 Kolommen, Kolossaal

```
┌─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┐
│             │             │             │
│   POSTER    │   POSTER    │   POSTER    │
│             │             │             │
├─────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────┤
│             │             │             │
│   POSTER    │   POSTER    │   POSTER    │
│             │             │             │
└─────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────┘
```

*   **3 kolommen**, full width (geen padding).
*   **Gap: 1px** rode lijn (`#af1d1f`) als scheiding.
*   **Aspect ratio:** A4 (1:1.414) voor elke poster.

---

### 3. Hover Interactie (Herwerkt)

Kijkend naar je inspiratie (Tarkovsky, Brutalism poster): de tekst zit er **IN** de compositie, niet er overheen als een overlay. Het is geïntegreerd.

**Nieuw concept: "The Reveal"**

*   **Default:** Poster is volledig zichtbaar. Geen info.
*   **Hover:**
    *   De poster blijft 100% zichtbaar (geen dimmen).
    *   **Titel** verschijnt **groot** in Playfair, **wit met harde zwarte achtergrond** (zoals een text selection of een krantenkop die er overheen is geplakt). Positie: linksonder, uitlijning links.
    *   **Datum** verschijnt klein in het Internet-font, rechtsonder, ook met zwarte achtergrond.
    *   **Downloads** verschijnt klein, links van de datum.
    *   De tekst blokken zijn **scherp rechthoekig** (geen rounded corners), en lijken als "labels" of "stamps" over de poster geplakt.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│         [ POSTER ]              │
│                                 │
│  ┌──────────────────┐           │
│  │ THE SACRIFICE    │           │
│  └──────────────────┘           │
│              ┌────────┐┌───────┐│
│              │ 12 DLS ││ 2024  ││
│              └────────┘└───────┘│
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

## **Finaal Plan v2: "The Black Archive"**

### 1. Typografie - Internet Font

**Meme fonts / Internet cultuur - nieuwe richting:**

**Voorstel A: [Comic Neue](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Comic+Neue)**
*   De "nette" versie van Comic Sans. Iedereen herkent dit als internet/meme cultuur. Ironisch maar leesbaar.

**Voorstel B: [Dela Gothic One](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Dela+Gothic+One)**
*   Zwaar, bold, in-your-face. Denk aan YouTube thumbnails, clickbait, schreeuwende internet koppen.

**Voorstel C: [Archivo Black](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Archivo+Black)**
*   Heel bold sans-serif. "BREAKING NEWS" energy. 

**Voorstel D: [Bebas Neue](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Bebas+Neue)**
*   DE internet/meme titel font. Overal gebruikt. Condensed, bold, schreeuwt.

**Voorstel E: Gewoon Arial/Helvetica**
*   Zo generiek dat het precies die "default internet" energie heeft. Microsoft Word, memes, alles.

**Mijn suggestie nu:** **Bebas Neue** voor de pure internet-meme energie, of **Arial** voor de ultieme "dit is het internet" generiekheid.

---

### 2. Grid

*   3 kolommen, full width.
*   **Gap: 1px wit** (`#ffffff`) als scheiding.
*   Posters A4 ratio.

---

### 3. Hover - Brutalistischer

Weg met de nette labels. We gaan rauwer.

**Concept: "The Stamp"**

*   **Default:** Poster zichtbaar, geen info.
*   **Hover:**
    *   **Titel** verschijnt in **Playfair**, maar dan **GROOT** - zo groot dat het buiten de poster lijkt te vallen of er net in past. Witte tekst, **geen achtergrond**. Harde schaduw of gewoon puur wit op de afbeelding.
    *   Positie: **schuin** (-3° tot -5° rotatie) of **verticaal langs de rand**.
    *   **Datum + Downloads:** Klein, in het Internet-font, ergens in een hoek. Puur wit tekst, geen box.
    *   Optioneel: een **rode lijn** (`#af1d1f`) die diagonaal door de poster snijdt of langs de onderkant loopt.

/* ==================== HEADER ==================== */
header {
    background: var(--black);
    padding: 3rem 2rem;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.logo {
    max-width: 200px;
    height: auto;
}

/* ==================== MAIN CONTENT ==================== */
main {
    max-width: 1800px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

/* ==================== POSTER GRID ==================== */
.poster-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(350px, 1fr));
    gap: 2rem;
}

.poster-card {
    background: var(--black);
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.4142;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.poster-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--white);
}

.poster-card:hover .poster-image {
    opacity: 0.9;
}

.poster-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    display: block;
}

.poster-info {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.95) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 70%, transparent 100%);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.poster-card:hover .poster-info {
    opacity: 1;
}

.poster-title {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    color: var(--white);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.poster-date {

}

.poster-downloads {

}

// Display posters in grid
function displayPosters(posters) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('poster-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = posters.map(poster => {
        // Use original JPEG instead of thumbnail to preserve exact colors (ICC profiles)
        // Thumbnails generated by PHP GD often strip color profiles, causing color shifts
        const imageUrl = poster.jpeg_filename ? `${BASE_URL}/uploads/${poster.jpeg_filename}` : 
                        (poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png');
        
        const uploadDate = poster.upload_date || poster.uploadDate || poster.created_at;
        const formattedDate = uploadDate ? new Date(uploadDate).toLocaleDateString('nl-NL', { 
            year: 'numeric', 
            month: '2-digit', 
            day: '2-digit' 
        }) : '';
        
        return `
        <div class="poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img class="poster-image" src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <div class="poster-info">
                <h3 class="poster-title">${poster.title}</h3>
                <div class="poster-meta">
                    <span class="poster-date">${formattedDate}</span>
                    <span class="poster-downloads">${poster.downloads || 0}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
    
    // Add click handlers
    grid.querySelectorAll('.poster-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const posterId = card.dataset.posterId;
            showPosterModal(posterId);
        });
    });
}
```

        const uploadDate = poster.upload_date || poster.uploadDate || poster.created_at;
        return `
        <div class="poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img class="poster-image" src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <div class="poster-info">
                <h3 class="poster-title">${poster.title}</h3>
                <p class="poster-date">${uploadDate ? new Date(uploadDate).toLocaleDateString('nl-NL') : ''}</p>
                <p class="poster-downloads">Downloads: ${poster.downloads || 0}</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
    
    // Add click handlers
    grid.querySelectorAll('.poster-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const posterId = card.dataset.posterId;
            showPosterModal(posterId);
        });
    });
}

// Show poster modal
async function showPosterModal(posterId) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters/${posterId}`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Kan poster niet laden');
        
        const poster = await response.json();
        currentPoster = poster;
        
        // Update modal content - use full size JPEG for modal
        const imageUrl = poster.jpeg_filename ? `${BASE_URL}/uploads/${poster.jpeg_filename}` : 
                        (poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png');
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-img').src = imageUrl;
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-img').onerror = function() { this.src = 'img/placeholder.png'; };
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-title').textContent = poster.title;
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-description').textContent = poster.description || '';
        
        // Location info
        let locationText = '';
        if (poster.location_description) {
            locationText = poster.location_description;
        }
        if (poster.latitude && poster.longitude) {
            locationText += locationText ? ` (${poster.latitude}, ${poster.longitude})` : `${poster.latitude}, ${poster.longitude}`;
        }
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-location').textContent = locationText ? `Locatie: ${locationText}` : '';
        
        // Article link
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-article').innerHTML = poster.artikel_link ? `<a href="${poster.artikel_link}" target="_blank">Lees het originele artikel</a>` : '';
        
        // Photographer credit
        document.getElementById('modal-poster-photographer').textContent = poster.photographer_credit ? `Foto: ${poster.photographer_credit}` : '';
        
        // Download count
        document.getElementById('modal-download-count').textContent = poster.downloads || 0;
        
        // Show modal
        document.getElementById('download-modal').style.display = 'block';
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading poster:', error);
    }
}
```

/* ==================== FONTS ==================== */
/* Playfair Display - Krant/Klassiek */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');
/* Bebas Neue - Internet Titels */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&display=swap');
/* Roboto - Internet Tekst */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap');
/* VT323 - Accent/Glitch */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=VT323&display=swap');
/* Comic Neue - Grapjes */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comic+Neue:wght@400;700&display=swap');

/* ==================== ALGEMENE STIJLEN ==================== */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

:root {
    --black: #000000;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --red: #af1d1f;
    
    /* Font Families */
    --font-klassiek: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
    --font-internet-title: 'Bebas Neue', Impact, sans-serif;
    --font-internet-text: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-accent: 'VT323', monospace;
    --font-meme: 'Comic Neue', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive;
}

body {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    background-color: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.4;
    font-weight: 400;
    position: relative;
}

/* Noise Overlay - Subtle film grain */
body::after {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 10000;
    opacity: 0.04;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
}

/* When AR is active, make body transparent */
body.ar-active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
}

/* ==================== HEADER ==================== */
header {
    background: var(--black);
    padding: 3rem 0;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;

.poster-grid {

}

}

/* ==================== FONTS ==================== */
/* Playfair Display - Krant/Klassiek - REGULAR ONLY */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display&display=swap');
/* Bebas Neue - Internet Titels - REGULAR ONLY */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&display=swap');
/* Roboto - Internet Tekst - REGULAR ONLY */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto&display=swap');
/* VT323 - Accent - USE SPARINGLY */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=VT323&display=swap');

/* ==================== ALGEMENE STIJLEN ==================== */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

:root {
    --black: #000000;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --red: #af1d1f;
    
    /* Font Families */
    --font-klassiek: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
    --font-internet-title: 'Bebas Neue', Impact, sans-serif;
    --font-internet-text: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-accent: 'VT323', monospace;
}

body {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    background-color: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.4;
    font-weight: 400;
    position: relative;
}

/* Noise Overlay - more gritty */
body::after {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 10000;
    opacity: 0.08;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
}

/* When AR is active, make body transparent */
body.ar-active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
}

/* ==================== HEADER ==================== */
header {
    background: var(--black);
    padding: 1.5rem 0;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}

.logo {
    width: 80px;
    height: auto;
}

/* ==================== MAIN CONTENT ==================== */
main {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

/* ==================== POSTER GRID ==================== */
.poster-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
}

.poster-card {
    background: var(--black);
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.4142;
}

.poster-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
}

/* Hover Info */
.poster-info {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.1s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
}

.poster-card:hover .poster-info {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* TITEL - 90° gedraaid, vult de hoogte */
.poster-title {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: auto;
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    text-orientation: mixed;
    transform: rotate(180deg);
    font-family: var(--font-klassiek);
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
    padding: 1rem 0.6rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    /* Random colors via JS */
}

/* Meta info - onderaan */
.poster-meta {
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
}

.poster-date {
    font-family: var(--font-accent);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
    /* Random colors via JS */
}

.poster-downloads {
    font-family: var(--font-accent);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
    /* Random colors via JS */
}

.poster-downloads::before {
    content: "↓";
}

.poster-description {
    display: none;
}

.download-count {
    display: none;
}

/* ==================== MODAL ==================== */
.modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 1000;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: auto;
    background-color: var(--black);
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
}

.modal-content {
    background-color: var(--black);
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* SLUITEN knop - Bebas Neue */
.close {
    position: fixed;
    top: 1.5rem;
    right: 1.5rem;
    font-family: var(--font-internet-title);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.1s;
    line-height: 1;
    z-index: 1001;
    background: var(--black);
    padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
}

.close:hover {
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
}

/* Modal Layout - DOSSIER */
.modal-body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding: 0;
}

.modal-image-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 2rem;
    background: #050505;
    position: relative;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}

.modal-info {
    padding: 2rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    background: var(--black);
    overflow-y: auto;
    max-height: 100vh;
}

/* VT323 voor data/database info */
.meta-info {
    font-family: var(--font-accent);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.article-link {
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

.article-link a {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    color: var(--white);
    text-decoration: underline;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.article-link a:hover {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
}

.download-section {
    margin-top: 2rem;
    padding-top: 1rem;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
}

/* Bebas Neue voor section headers */
.download-section h3 {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-title);
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
}

/* VT323 voor downloads stat */
.download-stat {
    font-family: var(--font-accent);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.download-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
}

#poster-info {
    text-align: left;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
}

#modal-poster-img {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 85vh;
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
}

/* Playfair voor titels */
#modal-poster-title {
    font-family: var(--font-klassiek);
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--white);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1.1;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

/* Roboto voor leestekst */
#modal-poster-description {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    margin: 0.8rem 0;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.modal-description {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    margin: 0.5rem 0;
    line-height: 1.6;
    font-weight: 400;
}

/* VT323 voor locatie/coordinaten/data */
.modal-location,
.modal-article,
.modal-photographer {
    font-family: var(--font-accent);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    margin: 0.3rem 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    text-align: left;
    line-height: 1.6;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.modal-location a,
.modal-article a {
    color: var(--white);
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.modal-location a:hover,
.modal-article a:hover {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
}

.modal-photographer {
    font-style: normal;
}

.download-options {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

/* Bebas Neue voor section titles */
.download-options h3 {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-title);
    font-size: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    color: var(--white);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.format-section {
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
}

.format-section h4 {
    display: none;
}

/* Bebas Neue voor knoppen */
.download-btn {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border-bottom: none;
    padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-internet-title);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.1s ease;
    text-align: left;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.download-btn:last-child {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

.download-btn:hover {
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
}

.download-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
}

/* ==================== ADMIN LINK ==================== */
.admin-link {
    position: fixed;
    top: 1rem;
    right: 1rem;
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    color: var(--white);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    z-index: 999;
    background: transparent;
    line-height: 1;
    opacity: 0.15;
}

.admin-link:hover {
    opacity: 1;
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
}

/* ==================== ADMIN STYLES ==================== */
.admin-container {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: var(--white);
}

.admin-container header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem 2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.admin-container h1 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--black);
}

.back-link {
    color: var(--black);
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    transition: all 0.15s;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.back-link:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

.admin-main {
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    padding: 0 2rem;
}

/* Login Section */
.login-section {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 3rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 4rem auto;
    text-align: center;
}

.login-section h2 {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

#login-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
}

#login-form input {
    padding: 1rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    transition: border-color 0.3s;
}

#login-form input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--black);
}

#login-form button {
    padding: 1rem;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

#login-form button:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

/* Upload Section */
.upload-card {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.upload-card h2 {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.form-group {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.form-group label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--black);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.form-group input,
.form-group textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.8rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: border-color 0.3s;
}

.form-group input:focus,
.form-group textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--black);
}

.file-info {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 300;
}

.preview-container {
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
    text-align: center;
}

.preview-container h3 {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--black);
}

#preview-image {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 300px;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.upload-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.upload-btn:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

.upload-btn:disabled {
    background: var(--white);
    border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* Messages */
.error-message {
    color: #ff6b6b;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.success-message {
    color: #51cf66;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Admin Poster List */
.posters-management {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.posters-management h2 {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--black);
}

.admin-poster-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.admin-poster-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    transition: all 0.15s;
}

.admin-poster-item:hover {
    background: var(--black);
}

.admin-poster-item:hover .admin-poster-item-info h4,
.admin-poster-item:hover .admin-poster-item-info p {
    color: var(--white);
}

.admin-poster-item:hover .delete-btn {
    color: var(--white);
    border-color: var(--white);
}

.admin-poster-item img {
    width: 80px;
    height: 113px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.admin-poster-item-info {
    flex: 1;
}

.admin-poster-item-info h4 {
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--black);
    transition: color 0.15s;
}

.admin-poster-item-info p {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    transition: color 0.15s;
}

.delete-btn {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--black);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 400;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.delete-btn:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

/* ==================== RESPONSIVE ==================== */
@media (max-width: 1400px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
    
    .modal-body {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
    
    .modal-image-container {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

    .modal-body {
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 2rem 0;
    }
    
    .modal-image-container {
        flex: none;
        padding: 1rem;
    }
    
    .modal-info {
        padding: 2rem;
    }

    #modal-poster-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .close {
        top: 1rem;
        right: 1rem;
    }

    .admin-container header {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
        align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .admin-poster-item {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
    }

    .logo {
        max-width: 100px;
    }

    header {
        padding: 1.5rem 0;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .poster-title {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        padding: 0.8rem 0.5rem;
    }

    .logo {
        max-width: 80px;
    }

    .modal-info {
        padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    #modal-poster-title {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    #modal-poster-img {
        max-height: 40vh;
    }

    .admin-link {
        top: 1rem;
        right: 1rem;
        font-size: 1rem;
        padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar styling */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 8px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: var(--black);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #333;
    border: 1px solid #222;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #444;
}

/* ==================== UPLOAD PROGRESS BAR ==================== */
.upload-progress {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    background: var(--white);
}

.progress-info {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--black);
}

.progress-text {
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.progress-percentage {
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--black);
}

.progress-bar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--black);
    width: 0%;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.upload-stats {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.upload-speed, .upload-eta {
    font-weight: 300;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

/* ==================== FILE SIZE INFO ==================== */
.file-size-info {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--black);
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0 0;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    display: none;
}

.file-size-info.show {
    display: block;
}

.file-size-info.large {
    color: #d32f2f;
    background: rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.1);
    border-color: rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.3);
}

.file-size-info.medium {
    color: #f57c00;
    background: rgba(245, 124, 0, 0.1);
    border-color: rgba(245, 124, 0, 0.3);
}

.file-size-info.small {
    color: #388e3c;
    background: rgba(56, 142, 60, 0.1);
    border-color: rgba(56, 142, 60, 0.3);
}

.total-size-summary {
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.total-size-summary h4 {
    margin: 0 0 0.8rem 0;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--black);
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.size-breakdown {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.size-item {
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.size-total {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--black);
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* ==================== EDIT MODAL ==================== */
.edit-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 2000;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: auto;
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
}

.edit-modal-content {
    background-color: var(--white);
    margin: 2% auto;
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    width: 90%;
    max-width: 700px;
    max-height: 90vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    position: relative;
}

.edit-modal-close {
    position: absolute;
    right: 1.5rem;
    top: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
    line-height: 1;
}

.edit-modal-close:hover {
    opacity: 0.6;
}

.edit-modal-content h2 {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.form-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.btn-primary,
.btn-secondary {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;

/* ==================== FONTS ==================== */
/* Playfair Display - Krant/Klassiek - TITELS */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display&display=swap');
/* Bebas Neue - KNOPPEN/UI */

/* ==================== ALGEMENE STIJLEN ==================== */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

:root {
    --black: #000000;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --red: #af1d1f;
    
    /* Font Families */
    --font-klassiek: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
    --font-internet-title: 'Bebas Neue', Impact, sans-serif;
    --font-internet-text: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-accent: 'VT323', monospace;
}

body {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    background-color: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.4;
    font-weight: 400;
    position: relative;
}

/* Noise Overlay - MORE GRITTY */
body::after {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 10000;
    opacity: 0.12;

}

body.ar-active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
}

/* ==================== HEADER ==================== */
header {
    background: var(--black);

    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);

.logo {

}

main {
    width: 100%;

}

.poster-grid {
    display: grid;

}

.poster-card {

}

.poster-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
}

.poster-info {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.1s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
}

.poster-card:hover .poster-info {
    opacity: 1;

/* TITEL - 90° gedraaid, vult de hoogte */
.poster-title {
    position: absolute;

    color: var(--black);
}

.download-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
}

/* ==================== ADMIN LINK ==================== */
.admin-link {
    position: fixed;
    top: 1rem;
    right: 1rem;
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    color: var(--white);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    z-index: 999;
    background: transparent;
    line-height: 1;
    opacity: 0.15;
}

.admin-link:hover {
    opacity: 1;
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

/* ==================== ADMIN STYLES ==================== */
.admin-container {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: var(--white);
}

.admin-container header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem 2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.admin-container h1 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--black);
}

.back-link {
    color: var(--black);
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    transition: all 0.15s;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.back-link:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

.admin-main {
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    padding: 0 2rem;
}

/* Login Section */
.login-section {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 3rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 4rem auto;
    text-align: center;
}

.login-section h2 {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

#login-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
}

#login-form input {
    padding: 1rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    transition: border-color 0.3s;
}

#login-form input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--black);
}

#login-form button {
    padding: 1rem;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

#login-form button:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

/* Upload Section */
.upload-card {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.upload-card h2 {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.form-group {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.form-group label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--black);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.form-group input,
.form-group textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.8rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: border-color 0.3s;
}

.form-group input:focus,
.form-group textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--black);
}

.file-info {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 300;
}

.preview-container {
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
    text-align: center;
}

.preview-container h3 {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--black);
}

#preview-image {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 300px;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.upload-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.upload-btn:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

.upload-btn:disabled {
    background: var(--white);
    border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* Messages */
.error-message {
    color: #ff6b6b;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.success-message {
    color: #51cf66;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Admin Poster List */
.posters-management {
    background: var(--white);
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.posters-management h2 {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--black);
}

.admin-poster-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.admin-poster-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    transition: all 0.15s;
}

.admin-poster-item:hover {
    background: var(--black);
}

.admin-poster-item:hover .admin-poster-item-info h4,
.admin-poster-item:hover .admin-poster-item-info p {
    color: var(--white);
}

.admin-poster-item:hover .delete-btn {
    color: var(--white);
    border-color: var(--white);
}

.admin-poster-item img {
    width: 80px;
    height: 113px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.admin-poster-item-info {
    flex: 1;
}

.admin-poster-item-info h4 {
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--black);
    transition: color 0.15s;
}

.admin-poster-item-info p {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    transition: color 0.15s;
}

.delete-btn {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--black);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 400;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.delete-btn:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

/* ==================== RESPONSIVE ==================== */
@media (max-width: 1400px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
    
    .modal-body {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
    
    .modal-image-container {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

    .modal-body {
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 2rem 0;
    }
    
    .modal-image-container {
        flex: none;
        padding: 1rem;
    }
    
    .modal-info {
        padding: 2rem;
    }

    #modal-poster-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .close {
        top: 1rem;
        right: 1rem;
    }

    .admin-container header {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
        align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .admin-poster-item {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
    }

    .logo {
        max-width: 100px;
    }

    header {
        padding: 1.5rem 0;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .poster-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .poster-title {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        padding: 0.8rem 0.5rem;
    }

    .logo {
        max-width: 80px;
    }

    .modal-info {
        padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    #modal-poster-title {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    #modal-poster-img {
        max-height: 40vh;
    }

    .admin-link {
        top: 1rem;
        right: 1rem;
        font-size: 1rem;
        padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar styling */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 8px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: var(--black);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #222;
    border: 1px solid #111;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #333;
}

/* ==================== UPLOAD PROGRESS BAR ==================== */
.upload-progress {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    background: var(--white);
}

.progress-info {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--black);
}

.progress-text {
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.progress-percentage {
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--black);
}

.progress-bar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--black);
    width: 0%;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.upload-stats {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.upload-speed, .upload-eta {
    font-weight: 300;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

/* ==================== FILE SIZE INFO ==================== */
.file-size-info {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--black);
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0 0;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    display: none;
}

.file-size-info.show {
    display: block;
}

.file-size-info.large {
    color: #d32f2f;
    background: rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.1);
    border-color: rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.3);
}

.file-size-info.medium {
    color: #f57c00;
    background: rgba(245, 124, 0, 0.1);
    border-color: rgba(245, 124, 0, 0.3);
}

.file-size-info.small {
    color: #388e3c;
    background: rgba(56, 142, 60, 0.1);
    border-color: rgba(56, 142, 60, 0.3);
}

.total-size-summary {
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.total-size-summary h4 {
    margin: 0 0 0.8rem 0;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--black);
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.size-breakdown {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.size-item {
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.size-total {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--black);
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* ==================== EDIT MODAL ==================== */
.edit-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 2000;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: auto;
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
}

.edit-modal-content {
    background-color: var(--white);
    margin: 2% auto;
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    width: 90%;
    max-width: 700px;
    max-height: 90vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    position: relative;
}

.edit-modal-close {
    position: absolute;
    right: 1.5rem;
    top: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
    line-height: 1;
}

.edit-modal-close:hover {
    opacity: 0.6;
}

.edit-modal-content h2 {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--black);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.form-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.btn-primary,
.btn-secondary {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
}

.btn-primary {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
    background: #333;
}

.btn-secondary {
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.edit-btn {
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    border: 1px solid var(--black);
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
}

.edit-btn:hover {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
}

/* ==================== MOBILE AR VIEW ==================== */
#mobile-ar-view {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    background: transparent;
    z-index: 9999;
    pointer-events: none;
}

#mobile-ar-view > #ar-header,
#mobile-ar-view > #ar-footer-swipe-bar {
    pointer-events: auto;
}

#ar-header {
    height: 10vh;
    height: 10dvh;
    min-height: 60px;
    background: var(--black);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 10001;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    pointer-events: auto;
}

#ar-header .logo,
#ar-header .ar-logo {
    max-height: 7vh;
    min-height: 40px;
    max-width: 80vw;
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    object-fit: contain;
}

#ar-camera-container {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: transparent;
    display: block;
    pointer-events: none;
}

#ar-scene,
a-scene {
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    z-index: 9996 !important;
}

#static-camera-feed {
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    object-fit: cover !important;
    z-index: 9997 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease !important;
}

#camera-feed,
video {
    display: block;
}

#ar-scene canvas,
a-scene canvas {
    display: block;
}

.mindar-ui-overlay,
.mindar-ui-scanning {
    display: none !important;
}

.scan-frame {
    position: fixed;
    top: calc(10vh + 10px);
    left: 30px;
    right: 30px;
    bottom: calc(6vh + 30px);
    border: 1px solid #ffffff;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 10;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 9999px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);
}

.scan-frame.hidden {
    opacity: 0;
}

.arjs-loader {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
    z-index: 10000;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.arjs-loader.hidden {
    display: none;
}

video {
    display: block !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
}

#ar-footer-swipe-bar {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 6vh;
    background: #af1d1f;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    transition: height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
    z-index: 999999;
    border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: none;
    box-shadow: 0 -4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
    pointer-events: auto;
}

#ar-footer-swipe-bar.expanded {
    height: 94vh;
    height: 94dvh;
}

.footer-header {
    height: 6vh;
    height: 6dvh;
    min-height: 60px;
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: none;
}

.swipe-indicator {
    display: none;
}

.swipe-state {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    padding: 0 24px;
    align-items: center;
}

.swipe-state.active {
    display: flex;
    opacity: 1;
}

#swipe-state-1 {
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.chevron-icon {
    color: #000;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
    opacity: 0.9;
}

#ar-footer-swipe-bar.expanded .chevron-icon {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.footer-text {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin: 0;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

#swipe-state-2 {
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.poster-info-footer {
    flex: 1;
}

#detected-poster-title {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin: 0;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

#detected-poster-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
    margin: 0 0 8px 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    opacity: 0.85;
}

.close-btn {
    background: transparent;
    color: #000;
    border: none;
    font-size: 2.8rem;
    line-height: 1;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    font-weight: 200;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    opacity: 0.9;
}

.close-btn:active {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    transform: scale(0.95);
}

#gallery-content {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    opacity: 0;
    padding-top: 1rem;
    touch-action: pan-y;
}

#ar-footer-swipe-bar.expanded #gallery-content {
    opacity: 1;
}

#detected-poster-content {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    opacity: 0;
    display: none;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    touch-action: pan-y;
}

#ar-footer-swipe-bar.expanded.detected-mode #detected-poster-content {
    opacity: 1;
    display: block;
}

#ar-footer-swipe-bar.expanded.detected-mode #gallery-content {
    display: none;
}

#detected-poster-details img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    display: block;
    background: #000;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

#detected-poster-details h2 {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #000;
    margin: 0 0 2rem 0;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 1.1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

#detected-poster-details p {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: #000;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
    font-weight: 400;
}

#detected-poster-details p strong {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

#gallery-overlay-grid {
    display: grid !important;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    gap: 2rem !important;
    padding: 0 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem !important;
}

.overlay-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 14px 20px;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    background: #D60024;
    z-index: 100;
    border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
}

.overlay-title {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #000;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.close-overlay-btn {
    background: transparent;
    color: #000;
    border: none;
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 300;

}

.overlay-poster-card:active {

}

.overlay-poster-card img {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    display: block !important;
    border: none !important;

}

.overlay-poster-card h3 {
    padding: 14px 12px !important;
    font-size: 0.85rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    color: #000 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    background: #fff !important;
}

#gallery-overlay-grid .poster-item {
    background: var(--white);
    color: var(--black);
    border: 2px solid var(--white);
    padding: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}

#gallery-overlay-grid .poster-item:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
}

#gallery-overlay-grid .poster-item img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;

    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--black);
}

#gallery-overlay-grid .poster-info {
    padding: 1rem;
}

#gallery-overlay-grid .poster-info h3 {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;

}

#desktop-view {

}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    /* Desktop view will be hidden via JS on mobile */
    /* AR view will be shown via JS on mobile */
}

/* ==================== A4 FRAME GUIDE ==================== */
.a4-frame {
    opacity: 1;

}

.a4-frame.hidden {
    opacity: 0;

.a4-frame-inner {

    border-radius: 0px;

    backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
    margin-top: -5vh;
}

// Generate random gray colors with minimum contrast
function generateRandomGrays() {
    // Generate base gray value (0-255)
    const baseGray = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
    // Ensure text has good contrast (at least 100 difference)
    const textGray = baseGray > 128 ? Math.max(0, baseGray - 120 - Math.floor(Math.random() * 50)) 
                                    : Math.min(255, baseGray + 120 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 50));
    
    return {
        bg: `rgb(${baseGray}, ${baseGray}, ${baseGray})`,
        text: `rgb(${textGray}, ${textGray}, ${textGray})`
    };
}

// Display posters in grid
function displayPosters(posters) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('poster-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = posters.map(poster => {
        // Use original JPEG instead of thumbnail to preserve exact colors
        const imageUrl = poster.jpeg_filename ? `${BASE_URL}/uploads/${poster.jpeg_filename}` : 
                        (poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png');
        
        const uploadDate = poster.upload_date || poster.uploadDate || poster.created_at;
        const formattedDate = uploadDate ? new Date(uploadDate).toLocaleDateString('nl-NL') : '';
        const downloads = poster.downloads || 0;
        
        // Random gray colors for this poster - regenerated each page load
        const titleColors = generateRandomGrays();
        const dateColors = generateRandomGrays();
        const downloadColors = generateRandomGrays();
        
        return `
        <div class="poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img class="poster-image" src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <div class="poster-info">
                <h3 class="poster-title" style="background: ${titleColors.bg}; color: ${titleColors.text};">${poster.title}</h3>
                <div class="poster-meta">
                    <span class="poster-date" style="background: ${dateColors.bg}; color: ${dateColors.text};">${formattedDate}</span>
                    <span class="poster-downloads" style="background: ${downloadColors.bg}; color: ${downloadColors.text};">${downloads}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
    
    // Add click handlers
    grid.querySelectorAll('.poster-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const posterId = card.dataset.posterId;
            showPosterModal(posterId);
        });
    });
}
```

// Display posters in grid
function displayPosters(posters) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('poster-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = posters.map(poster => {
        const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png';
        const uploadDate = poster.upload_date || poster.uploadDate || poster.created_at;
        const formattedDate = uploadDate ? new Date(uploadDate).toLocaleDateString('nl-NL') : '';
        const downloads = poster.downloads || 0;
        
        // Random gray colors for this poster - regenerated each page load
        const titleColors = generateRandomGrays();
        const dateColors = generateRandomGrays();
        const downloadColors = generateRandomGrays();
        
        // Hacker symbols for data
        const symbols = ['>', '//', '#', '$', '@', '::'];
        const randomSymbol = symbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * symbols.length)];
        
        return `
        <div class="poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img class="poster-image" src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <div class="poster-info">
                <h3 class="poster-title" style="background: ${titleColors.bg}; color: ${titleColors.text};">${poster.title}</h3>
                <div class="poster-meta">
                    <span class="poster-date" style="background: ${dateColors.bg}; color: ${dateColors.text};">${randomSymbol} ${formattedDate}</span>
                    <span class="poster-downloads" style="background: ${downloadColors.bg}; color: ${downloadColors.text};">${downloads}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
```

/* ==================== FONTS ==================== */
/* Playfair Display - Krant/Klassiek - TITELS */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display&display=swap');
/* Bebas Neue - KNOPPEN/UI */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&display=swap');
/* Roboto - LEESTEKST */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto&display=swap');
/* VT323 - DATA/DATABASE INFO */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=VT323&display=swap');

/* ==================== ALGEMENE STIJLEN ==================== */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

:root {
    --black: #000000;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --red: #af1d1f;
    
    /* Font Families */
    --font-klassiek: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
    --font-internet-title: 'Bebas Neue', Impact, sans-serif;
    --font-internet-text: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-accent: 'VT323', monospace;
}

body {
    font-family: var(--font-internet-text);
    background-color: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.4;
    font-weight: 400;
    position: relative;
}

/* Noise Overlay - MORE GRITTY */
body::after {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 10000;
    opacity: 0.15;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
}
